Job title

Growth Marketing Manager - Financial Solutions

Department

Marketing

Reports to

Director of Marketing

Classification

Full-Time

Work Location

Remote (50-miles within Atlanta, GA)

Travel Requirement

Occasional travel is required, including attendance at BELAY's annual company Summit and other business meetings as needed.

Job purpose

The Growth Marketing Manager – Financial Solutions leads the marketing strategy for BELAY's Financial Solutions service line, with responsibility for driving pipeline, revenue growth, and marketing efficiency. As the service line's marketing subject matter expert, this role develops a deep understanding of the ideal customer profile (ICP), customer needs, market dynamics, and BELAY's value proposition to inform positioning, campaigns, and growth strategies.

This role partners closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Creative, and other Marketing functions to translate business and customer insights into measurable growth initiatives. The Growth Marketing Manager also leads a team responsible for executing and optimizing marketing strategies across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion and ongoing engagement.

Essential Functions

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

People Leadership & Planning

  • Lead, coach, and develop team members while establishing clear priorities, expectations, and accountability.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings focused on feedback, development, and performance.
  • Manage internal resources, contractors, and vendors to effectively execute marketing priorities.
  • Partner with the Director of Marketing to establish and execute annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing priorities.
  • Foster strong collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and other key business partners.

Growth & Financial Performance

  • Own Marketing's contribution to Financial Solutions pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations to develop growth forecasts, lead projections, and performance targets.
  • Monitor marketing investment against pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition, and ROI, adjusting strategies and spend based on performance.
  • Develop data-driven business cases and recommendations for new marketing investments and growth opportunities.
  • Regularly present business performance, insights, and growth recommendations to senior leadership.

Service Line & Acquisition Strategy

  • Serve as the Marketing subject matter expert for Financial Solutions, developing a deep understanding of the ICP, customer needs, buying behaviors, competitive landscape, and service line value proposition.
  • Use customer insights, market trends, competitive research, and performance data to inform marketing strategy, segmentation, and messaging.
  • Conduct regular competitive analysis, including an annual SWOT analysis, to identify opportunities and potential threats.
  • Own the marketing funnel from awareness through qualified pipeline, partnering with Sales to improve lead quality and conversion.
  • Develop and execute integrated, omnichannel acquisition campaigns across owned, paid, partner, and other relevant channels.
  • Identify opportunities to expand into new audiences, verticals, and channels and develop cross-sell strategies across BELAY service lines.
  • Partner with Content, Creative, Paid Digital, and external vendors to execute ICP-aligned campaigns and support service line growth.

Experimentation & Optimization

  • Develop and maintain a cross-channel experimentation roadmap across paid media, sponsorships, landing pages, messaging, offers, and nurture programs.
  • Design and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests to improve conversion, acquisition efficiency, and customer engagement.
  • Prioritize growth initiatives and experiments based on business impact, resources, data, and strategic alignment.
  • Scale high-performing strategies while optimizing or discontinuing underperforming initiatives.
  • Stay current on marketing trends, technologies, and emerging channels to identify new opportunities for sustainable growth.

Marketing Operations & Sales Enablement

  • Leverage Salesforce, HubSpot, and other marketing technologies to support campaign execution, reporting, funnel visibility, and optimization.
  • Ensure brand consistency and alignment across Financial Solutions campaigns and channels.
  • Provide Sales with messaging, content, tools, and resources that support lead conversion and revenue generation.
  • Support special projects, strategic initiatives, and research as business needs evolve.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, product marketing, or lead generation.
  • 1+ years of people leadership or direct team management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing strategies tied to pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition, or other measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience developing and executing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and make data-driven recommendations.
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Creative, or similar business functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial services, accounting, bookkeeping, fractional finance, or other professional services.
  • Experience with HubSpot and Salesforce or comparable CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience managing paid media, agencies, vendors, contractors, or sponsorships.
  • Experience with marketing forecasting, attribution, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, ROI analysis, or conversion optimization.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic and commercially minded with the ability to connect marketing initiatives to business outcomes.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team development skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines effectively.
  • Growth and experimentation mindset with the ability to test, learn, and adapt.
  • Strong customer and market orientation.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and ability to quickly learn new technologies.

Working Conditions

BELAY is a remote-first organization. This role requires a dedicated home office, regular use of virtual collaboration tools, and a work schedule that aligns with business needs and BELAY's core collaboration hours. Occasional travel or flexibility outside standard business hours may be required based on the role.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
  • Frequent participation in virtual meetings.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through video conferencing, email, and phone.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Direct Reports

  • Marketing Strategist - Financial Solutions
  • Partnership Manager - Financial Solutions
  • Paid Digital Marketing Specialist - Financial Solutions

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Responsibilities may change from time to time based on business needs, and team members may be assigned additional duties as needed.

Equal Employment Opportunity

BELAY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Compensation:

Salary Range: OTE $90-100K

Location Requirements:

This role is remote within the U.S. However, due to employment and tax compliance considerations, we are currently unable to hire employees in the following states: California, New York, Illinois, Oregon.

The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

  • Provide coaching, assign work, and support team development and performance tracking.

  • Monitor team performance across key metrics including customer satisfaction, retention, and portfolio growth.
  • Support client engagements and assist with escalations to ensure positive outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Implementation teams to drive alignment and improve customer experience.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements within defined operational guidelines.
  • Contribute to departmental planning and represent the team in cross-functional meetings.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Public Administration, a related field, or relevant experience.

  • Familiarity with digital transformation initiatives and enterprise SaaS delivery.

Other Job Info: This role is typically performed on a computer using Zoom or Teams. The individual will be on camera throughout the day engaging with other employees and clients. The role is typically performed indoors within a home office environment. This role is typically performed while sitting or standing at a desk.

raw.description:
Verantworte Wachstum - in unseren Kampagnen, dem gesamten Funnel und im Team.

Für unseren Kooperationspartner, ein stark wachsendes Seed-Start-up, suchen wir eine:n Growth Marketing Manager (m/w/d), der Meta/LinkedIn selbst beherrscht, relevante Budgets skaliert und den gesamten Funnel bis zum qualifizierten Lead optimiert.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle in der Weiterentwicklung der Marketing- und Growth-Engine von unserem Kooperationspartner und arbeitest eng mit den Foundern zusammen.

  • Wachstumspotenzial: Wir wollen jemanden, der es gewohnt ist, operativ anzupacken, Projekte zu strukturieren und Menschen zu leiten - mit der Perspektive auf Head of Growth
  • Paid Social skalieren: Du steuerst und optimierst Meta- und LinkedIn-Kampagnen eigenständig – von Setup und Testing bis zur Skalierung.
  • Full-Funnel-Denken: Du schaust auf den gesamten Weg bis zum qualifizierten Sales Lead und entwickelst daraus konkrete Maßnahmen.
  • Performance verstehen: CAC, CPA, ROAS und Conversion Rates sind für dich Grundlage deiner Entscheidungen.
  • Tracking & Reporting aufsetzen: Du arbeitest hands-on mit GA4, GTM, UTM-Parametern und HubSpot und stellst sicher, dass Performance sauber messbar ist.
  • Funnel optimieren: Du identifizierst Bottlenecks, entwickelst Tests und verbesserst Landingpages, Lead-Nurturing und Conversion-Prozesse.
  • AI nutzen: Du entwickelst mit HubSpot, Make, Zapier und AI-Tools effizientere Marketing- und Nurturing-Prozesse.
  • Google Ads mitdenken: Du kannst Kampagnen und Ergebnisse fundiert bewerten, Freelancer steuern und den Kanal perspektivisch stärker intern übernehmen.
  • Neue Wachstums-Chancen erkennen: TikTok, Native Ads, Creator-Kampagnen oder Affiliate-Modelle können künftig dazukommen. Du bewertest, was skalierbar ist und was nicht.
  • Strukturen schaffen: Du baust Prozesse so auf, dass Wachstum nicht vom Zufall abhängt – von Kampagnenstrukturen über Reporting bis zu wiederholbaren Tests.
  • Tools: GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM-Strukturen, Make, Zapier, HubSpot & immer offen für Neues

Wichtig: Hier geht es nicht um Branding, Design oder Community Management. Der Kern deiner Rolle ist Performance, Growth, Conversion und Skalierung.

Qualifikation

  • 3–5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
  • Start-up, Scale-up oder Agency-Erfahrung: Du bist es gewohnt, dass Prioritäten sich schnell verändern und Eigeninitiative entscheidend ist.
  • Meta Ads und LinkedIn Ads hands-on: Kampagnen selbstständig aufsetzen, analysieren und skalieren.
  • Performanceorientierte Steuerung von skalierenden Werbebudgets.
  • Full-Funnel-Strategien entwickeln und umsetzen.
  • Sicher mit Tracking, Reporting und Performance-Daten.
  • Erfahrung mit GA4, GTM und HubSpot.
  • Google Ads verstehen – du musst hier kein absoluter Spezialist sein.
  • Erfahrung mit Automation und AI-Tools wie Make, Zapier, Claude oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.
  • strukturiertes und organisiertes Arbeiten, ohne an Geschwindigkeit zu verlieren.
  • Erfahrung mit Projekt- oder Teamverantwortung.
  • sehr gutes Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1).

Nice to have: Erfahrung mit SEO/SEA, Landingpage-Optimierung bzw. Webflow, TikTok Ads, Native Advertising, Creator-/Influencer-Kampagnen oder Affiliate-Modellen.

Benefits

Warum ist diese Rolle spannend für dich

  • Echte Ownership - Du bekommst nicht nur Briefings, sondern gestaltest Strategie, Tests und Prioritäten selbst mit.
  • Direkter Einfluss auf Wachstum - Marketing soll zu einem der zentralen Wachstumstreiber des Unternehmens werden – und du bekommst die Möglichkeit, diesen Bereich entscheidend mit aufzubauen.
  • Direkter Draht zu den Foundern - Kurze Entscheidungswege, schnelle Tests und wenig Konzernpolitik.
  • Perspektive Head of Growth - Wenn du zeigst, dass du Growth erfolgreich aufbauen und skalieren kannst, soll deine Verantwortung mit dem Unternehmen wachsen, perspektivisch auch mit Teamverantwortung.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum - Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Strukturen, Prozesse und neue Kanäle selbst mit aufzubauen.

Unser Kooperationspartner digitalisiert einen Prozess, der traditionell von Papier, Bürokratie und langen Wartezeiten geprägt ist, und hat dafür eine digitale Lösung entwickelt.

Die nächste Herausforderung lautet deshalb nicht mehr nur:
„Wie bekommen wir mehr Traffic?“

Sondern:

„Wie bauen wir eine Growth Engine, die messbar, wiederholbar und skalierbar neue Kunden gewinnt?“
Genau dabei sollst du eine zentrale Rolle übernehmen.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Level? Dann bewirb dich jetzt online.

Growing Jumio’s pipeline, revenue, and market share in a rapidly expanding domain are fundamental to Jumio’s continued success. Account Executives are at the heart of the company’s global expansion and directly impact revenue, profitability and EBITDA. New customers and new revenue streams increase the value of the business and the impact we make on improving the world of online identity verification. This position reports to the Regional Sales Director, West.

  • Delivering against agreed new business sales targets, revenue and new logo customer acquisition

  • Working collaboratively with colleagues in pre-sales, marketing and account management to provide outstanding customer experience

  • Existing knowledge of the ID verification, AML or KYC market

raw.description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

The Identity Management Engineer / Architect designs, implements, and operates a secure, scalable enterprise identity platform spanning on-premises, cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for automated identity provisioning and deprovisioning, strong authentication, least-privilege access, modern application federation, privileged account management, and continuous identity governance, monitoring, and auditing.

This position is foundational to the Zero Trust identity pillar and ensures that users, administrators, applications, and workloads receive appropriate access based on verified identity, policy, risk, and mission requirements. The engineer/architect will support government and regulated environments through PIV/CAC smart-card authentication, phishing-resistant MFA, FICAM-aligned identity practices, privileged-access controls, and secure integration across enterprise identity platforms.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and operate enterprise IAM / ICAM architectures supporting on-premises, cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments.
  • Engineer and maintain directory services, including Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID where included in the approved architecture.
  • Design and automate user provisioning, deprovisioning, role assignment, access changes, and identity lifecycle management processes.
  • Integrate enterprise applications using modern identity and federation standards including SAML, OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth, and SCIM.
  • Implement and maintain Privileged Access Management (PAM) controls for administrative, elevated, and high-risk accounts.
  • Design and operate Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) capabilities using SailPoint or approved enterprise identity-governance platforms.
  • Integrate and administer AWS IAM Identity Center and related AWS identity and access-management capabilities.
  • Implement PIV/CAC smart-card authentication, certificate-based authentication, and other approved strong-authentication mechanisms.
  • Enforce phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication for privileged and mission-critical access.
  • Align identity architectures, authentication methods, credential lifecycle processes, and access controls with FICAMrequirements and applicable government identity standards.

  • Experience integrating identity platforms with SaaS applications, cloud services, enterprise applications, and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Experience with centralized logging, identity monitoring, audit reporting, access reviews, and compliance evidence collection.
  • Experience supporting government, defense, GovCloud, or other regulated environments is preferred.

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

  • The Creative Account Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our Creative team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between Creative Team members, other members of the Project Management team, and the client. This role will report directly to the Associate Director, Enterprise Operations, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

    This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering creative digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion. They will become part of a high-performing team that gets projects completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment. Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, projects and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives. As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your projects moving forward on-time without compromising quality. They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

    In addition, this role may provide support to the Creative Project Manager team, which is responsible for oversight and trafficking of tasks and activities in support of the Creative production team. This team is responsible for ensuring that assets move through the Creative process within designated SLAs and are delivered to the client on-time.

Responsibilities:

Role Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency with web-based project management platforms (Asana required)
  • Subject matter familiarity with digital creative environments a plus (e.g. design/editing figma/adobe)
  • CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
  • Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
  • Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
  • Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness

raw.description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Xsolla is seeking a Head of Investor Relations for the Xsolla Credit Fund, whose primary mandate is LP capital raising. While Xsolla's Capital Markets team covers investor relations across all of the company's strategic vehicles, this role is dedicated to the credit fund. Over time the role will also support fundraising for other Xsolla investment products, but the credit fund remains the primary focus.This is a relationship-led role. We are looking for someone who brings an established network of LP relationships — family offices, credit and alternatives allocators, funds of funds, and institutions — and who can open doors, engage principals, and personally steward investors from first conversation through diligence to commitment.

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

Beyond its core commerce platform, Xsolla is building a private credit fund that lends to video game studios and gaming businesses, underwritten with a data advantage no traditional lender has: Xsolla's own payments telemetry across thousands of games. The fund is in its capital formation phase and is led by Stan Rudoi, Chief Credit Officer. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help raise a first-time fund inside a profitable, global gaming-commerce company, alongside the broader Xsolla capital markets ecosystem (Xsolla Funding Club, Xsolla SPAC 1 — Nasdaq: XSLLU, and other strategic vehicles).

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities

    LP Relationships and Origination

  • Bring and grow the network: activate your existing LP relationships and originate new ones across family offices, credit and alternatives allocators, funds of funds, and institutions.
  • Engage principals: represent the fund credibly with decision-makers and investment committees, and match opportunities to each investor's mandate and ticket size.
  • Source and qualify the wider funnel: from conferences, investor databases, introductions, Xsolla contacts, and external research — qualified and prioritized by mandate fit.
  • Steward each relationship through diligence, negotiation, and commitment — and after the close, as the foundation of the fund's long-term LP base.

    • Follow-Through and Pipeline Discipline

  • Drive follow-through from first contact to meeting, diligence, soft interest, and closed commitment — no lead goes stale.
  • Prepare and send investor outreach and follow-ups; capture meeting notes, next steps, and commitment tracking after every interaction.
  • Maintain clean CRM reporting: pipeline status, activity, outcomes, blockers, priorities, and weekly progress — so leadership always knows conversion rates, stage aging, and next actions per LP.
  • Provide regular internal fund progress reporting to Xsolla leadership via Slack and other internal tools. A junior IR hire will take on pipeline operations as the raise scales.

    • Fundraising Materials and Messaging

  • Support and continuously improve investor materials: pitch deck, FAQs, data room, and meeting-specific talking points.
  • Refine LP messaging, fund thesis, objection handling, and investor segmentation based on live market feedback.
  • Write concise, institutional-quality investor emails, follow-ups, and presentation language.

    • Diligence and Fund Setup Support

  • Coordinate LP diligence requests across internal Xsolla teams, external advisors, legal, finance, and leadership.
  • Support fund setup workstreams: data room preparation and upkeep, reporting readiness, and document management.
  • Collect and synthesize investor feedback on fund terms, structure, risk-return profile, reporting, and allocation preferences to inform fund design.

    • Cross-Product Fundraising Support

  • As capacity allows, extend the same funnel discipline and materials support to other Xsolla investment products and strategic vehicles, in coordination with the Capital Markets team.

Qualifications and Skills

    Experience

  • 7+ years in investor relations, placement, private funds, investment banking, private credit, venture capital, private equity, family office, or institutional fundraising.
  • An established, referenceable network of LP relationships — family offices, credit and alternatives allocators, funds of funds, or institutions — that you can activate for a first-time fund. This is the core requirement for the role.
  • A track record of raising institutional capital, with a strong understanding of LP fundraising mechanics: fund materials, diligence processes, investor segmentation, and the private fund lifecycle.
  • Direct exposure to private credit or first-time fund raises is a strong plus.

    • Skills and Competencies

  • Excellent business English; able to write concise investor emails, follow-ups, FAQs, and presentation language without supervision.
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets, CRM, tracking, reporting, and project management discipline.
  • Commercial, structured, responsive, and able to manage many parallel investor conversations without dropping threads.
  • The gravitas and credibility to engage principals, investment committees, and senior allocators as a peer.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive fund and investor information.
  • Interest in gaming, fintech, private credit, alternative investments, or digital platforms preferred.

    • Education and Credentials

  • A bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, or a related field is preferred.
  • CFA / CAIA or relevant securities licenses are viewed favorably but not required.

Benefits

We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the Fair Chance Act.

Criminal History Consideration

For the Head of Investor Relations – Credit Fundposition, we will conduct a background check that may include the following:

  • Criminal history check
  • Employment verification
  • Education verification
  • Credit history check

Relevance to Job Responsibilities

The background check is relevant to this position because of the following role responsibilities:

  • Handling sensitive financial information and supporting fund analytics, financial models, and deal data
  • Accessing confidential company data
  • Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements

Rights Under the Fair Chance Act

Applicants are encouraged to inquire about their rights under the Fair Chance Act. If you have questions regarding our hiring practices, please contact .

By submitting the following job application form, you consent to Xsolla processing your data for career-related inquiries and potential employment opportunities. We process your data in accordance with this Xsolla Privacy Notice for Job Applicants. Please direct any inquiries regarding your data privacy to .

raw.excerpt: Leave Case Management• Serve as the primary internal point of contact for teammates, practice leadership, and HR partners regarding leave of absence processes, case status, and next steps.
raw.description:
Leave Case Management

  • Serve as the primary internal point of contact for teammates, practice leadership, and HR partners regarding leave of absence processes, case status, and next steps.
  • Guide teammates and leaders through the process for initiating leave requests with Alliance’s third party leave administrator.
  • Own internal leave case coordination from initiation through return to work or case closure, ensuring required actions and follow-up are completed timely.
  • Coordinate with the third party leave administrator regarding leave status, outstanding documentation, extensions, anticipated return to work dates, and other case related activity.
  • Monitor active and pending leave cases and maintain accurate internal tracking of leave dates, case status, anticipated return to work dates, and outstanding actions.
  • Proactively follow up with teammates, practice leadership, HR partners, and the third-party leave administrator when information or action is outstanding.
  • Communicate relevant leave status updates and next steps to internal stakeholders while maintaining appropriate confidentiality of employee medical information.
  • Coordinate return to work activities, including tracking required documentation, confirming return dates, and communicating identified work restrictions to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Identify and escalate complex, sensitive, high-risk, or unusual situations to Benefits or HR leadership as appropriate.

Workplace Accommodation Support

  • Support the workplace accommodation interactive process by coordinating documentation, tracking requests, facilitating communication, and ensuring timely follow-up.
  • Serve as a point of contact for teammates regarding the accommodation process, required documentation, and next steps.
  • Escalate accommodation requests requiring assessment, determination, or additional review to the appropriate HR Partner.

Compliance and Multi-State Leave Support

  • Maintain working knowledge of federal, state, and local leave and accommodation requirements, including FMLA, ADA, PWFA, applicable state and local leave programs, and Alliance leave policies.
  • Stay informed of changes to leave and accommodation requirements and assist with updates to internal procedures, resources, communications, and tracking processes as needed.
  • Support consistent administration of leave processes across Alliance practices while recognizing jurisdiction-specific requirements.
  • Partner with Benefits and HR leadership to identify situations requiring additional compliance review or guidance.

Payroll Coordination

  • Coordinate with Payroll regarding benefit deductions, premium arrears, employee status changes, and other pay or benefit matters arising during a leave of absence.
  • Identify and assist with resolving discrepancies among third-party administrator records, HRIS information, payroll records, benefits information, and employee status.
  • Ensure appropriate internal stakeholders receive timely information regarding leave changes that may impact employee pay, benefits, or employment status.
  • Review third-party administrator case activity for completeness and alignment with internal records and follow up on discrepancies or outstanding items.
  • Escalate vendor service concerns, delayed activity, or recurring case issues to Benefits leadership as appropriate.

Practice and HR Partnership

  • Build strong working relationships with practice leadership, HR Partners, Payroll, or other internal partners.
  • Provide responsive and knowledgeable support to practices regarding leave related questions, documentation requirements, case status, and next steps.
  • Provide appropriate updates regarding employee leave status, anticipated return dates, restrictions, and outstanding actions while protecting confidential information.
  • Communicate complex leave processes in a clear, practical, and teammate-focused manner.
  • Provide consistent, empathetic support to teammates navigating leave and accommodation situations.

Tracking, Reporting, and Process Support

  • Maintain accurate leave records within internal tracking tools, HRIS, and applicable vendor systems.
  • Routinely review open cases to identify outstanding actions, upcoming return dates, leave exhaustion, documentation follow-up, or other items requiring attention.
  • Support leave-related reporting, audits, and data reconciliation to promote accurate and consistent records.
  • Recommend and support improvements to internal leave processes, resources, communications, and workflows.
  • Assist with leave and accommodation projects and initiatives as assigned
  • 2+ years of direct experience supporting leave of absence, disability, and/or workplace accommodation processes.
  • Working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, PWFA, state and local leave programs, and employee leave administration.
  • Experience supporting or coordinating leave programs within a multi-state organization.
  • Experience working with a third-party leave administrator, disability carrier, or similar vendor preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up activities simultaneously in a detail-oriented environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain processes clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to develop effective working relationships across multiple levels and functions of an organization.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee and medical information appropriately.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to recognize when an issue requires escalation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience with ADP Workforce Now or a comparable HRIS platform.

WE ARE A DRUG-FREE, SMOKE-FREE, EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

Company Policy & Federal & State Laws Forbid Discrimination Because of Age, Color, Race, Religion, Sex, Disability, Sexual Orientation or National Origin

For additional details including our full equal opportunity statement, texting/outreach communication authorization, physical requirements of the job and more, please visit

The Leave of Absence Specialist serves as Alliance Animal Health's primary internal resource for coordinating employee leaves of absence and workplace accommodations across a complex, multi-state organization. The Specialist owns internal leave case coordination from initiation through return to work, partnering closely with teammates, practice leadership, HR Partners, Payroll, Benefits, and Alliance's third-party leave administrator to provide a consistent and supportive teammate experience.

This role monitors leave activity and key case milestones, maintains accurate internal records, coordinates required follow-up, and helps ensure teammates and leaders understand leave processes and next steps. The Leave of Absence Specialist also supports workplace accommodation processes by coordinating documentation, facilitating communication, and tracking requests through resolution while partnering with HR on matters requiring review or determination.

Success in this role requires strong organization and follow-through, sound judgment, excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and working knowledge of federal, state, and local leave and accommodation requirements.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading solution architecture, guiding iterative delivery of user-centric services, and contributing to the development of architectural standards and practices that enable efficient, effective, and affordable digital services.

The Solution Architect will guide teams in rapid, iterative delivery with solution designs that align to architectural vision and technical standards. Responsibilities include developing architectural plans with citizen-centered design principles, uncovering system context, providing technical recommendations and prototypes, reviewing and contributing to code changes, mentoring team members, and communicating architectural information to both technical and non-technical audiences. The Digital Architect may be required to work across one to two projects simultaneously and may perform development work as needed. A strong technical understanding of current and emerging technologies, combined with business acumen and project leadership skills, is essential.

Qualifications

raw.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Dominance & Strike team develops the most advanced combat aircraft and systems that ensure our forces own the skies and strike with precision when it matters most. From next-generation fighters to autonomous unmanned systems, we're building the future of aerial warfare. When pilots take off on missions, when commanders make split-second decisions, when national security hangs in the balance—our technology is there. We're not just building aircraft; we're building the edge that keeps our nation safe and our warfighters protected.

As a Recruiting Leader, You're Building:
The teams behind Advanced Effects and the Barracuda & Roadrunner families. AE is the largest revenue driver in AD&S, multi-billion dollar portfolio, and top 3 revenue driver of Anduril across all divisions. You'll find the aerospacialty engineers designing stealth capabilities, the software developers programming AI vehicle integration, the systems integrators making it all work seamlessly, and the program leaders bringing billion-dollar programs to life.

Every hire you make directly contributes to platforms that protect lives, secure freedoms, and maintain peace through strength. This isn't just recruiting—it's mission-essential talent acquisition for programs that literally define air superiority.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Recruiting Manager, you are the single-threaded owner of talent delivery for a Business Line and/or Strategic Program within one of Anduril's Divisions. You combine strategic business partnership with direct people leadership. This role exists at the intersection of strategy and execution. You are embedded deeply within your Business Line - understanding its programs, products, revenue drivers, and leadership priorities at a level that allows you to translate business objectives into hiring strategies, prioritize demand against capacity, and ensure the right talent lands on the right programs at the right time.

As a Sr. Recruiting Manger, you add direct people leadership - owning performance management, coaching, career development, and capacity allocation for a team of recruiters while simultaneously acting as the strategic advisor for your key stakeholders.

You are the voice of the business to TA and the voice of TA to the business. You own the hiring plan, the reporting, the escalations, and the outcomes. This is the formalized leadership layer within our Business Line construct - the person who ensures every major program and initiative has the talent it needs to hit its milestones.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Strategic Business Partnership & Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end TA strategy for your assigned Business Line, including headcount planning, demand management, requisition prioritization, and delivery against hiring targets tied to program milestones and revenue commitments.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to BL leadership (VP, Program Directors, General Managers, and Division Heads), using market intelligence, hiring data, and capacity models to influence decisions and shape the talent roadmap.
  • Define and manage hiring goals, SLAs, and success metrics for your Business Line — reporting progress through dashboards and business reviews with full transparency on pipeline health, risks, and capacity.
  • Partner with Division BizOps, Finance, and Workforce Planning to align on headcount allocation, budget, hiring sequencing, and revenue-driven demand changes.
  • Own all hiring progress reporting for your Business Line, delivering regular updates to divisional leadership and acting as the primary escalation point for hiring blockers.

Recruiting Execution & Delivery

  • Set the standard for recruiting excellence: sourcing strategy, candidate engagement, assessment rigor, and closing. You are the bar that your team calibrates against.
  • Maintain hands-on market expertise by actively recruiting on a select portfolio, ensuring you deeply understand talent availability, compensation dynamics, and competitive positioning for your BL's role families.
  • Lead major cross-functional hiring initiatives and surge efforts for your BL — batch days, high-volume campaigns, and ramp-to-milestone sprints — acting as the single-threaded owner for program execution.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Provide direct people leadership for recruiters aligned to your Business Line: performance management, coaching, mentorship, career development, and structured feedback through regular 1:1s.
  • Manage recruiter allocation, capacity, and performance tracking — acting as the single source of truth for the Divisional Head of TA on team health and delivery confidence.
  • Foster a high-performance culture that emphasizes skill development, collaboration, data discipline, and delivering a world-class candidate and hiring manager experience.
  • Provide structured, high-quality feedback into recruiter performance reviews, ensuring business impact and hiring outcomes are recognized alongside activity metrics.

Functional Excellence & Process Rigor

  • Drive consistency in role intakes, interview processes, compensation calibration, and candidate experience across your BL — ensuring every search runs to a standard, not ad hoc.
  • Champion cross-BL collaboration and candidate sharing within your Division — optimizing talent placement and ensuring fungible, high-quality pipelines across programs.
  • Proactively identify process gaps, hiring bottlenecks, and systemic issues within your BL portfolio — building sustainable solutions rather than one-off fixes.
  • Partner with Recruiting Operations on tooling, reporting, and automation opportunities specific to your BL's hiring patterns.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Years of experience commensurate with level and track:
  • 10+ years of progressive TA experience, with significant experience owning a business unit's hiring strategy. Fully autonomous. Demonstrated ability to partner with and influence VP-level stakeholders.
  • Proven full-cycle recruiting experience in a complex technical environment — you must be credible as a practitioner, not just a strategist.
  • Strong business acumen: ability to connect hiring outcomes to program milestones, revenue commitments, and capacity models.
  • Excellent analytical skills — experience using data to drive prioritization, tell a story to leadership, and hold a team accountable to outcomes.
  • Experience leading hiring initiatives beyond individual searches: surge campaigns, batch hiring, portfolio prioritization, capacity planning.
  • Ability to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous environments, managing competing priorities with sound judgment and minimal oversight.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in frontier-tech, defense, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing industries with understanding of clearance requirements, site-based hiring, and program-driven demand.
  • Direct experience managing or leading a team of recruiters
  • Experience partnering with BizOps, Finance, and HR Business Partners on workforce planning, budget alignment, and headcount governance.
  • Formal program or project management background (PMP, Agile, or similar).
  • Experience building and scaling recruiting operations for a specific business unit during a period of high growth or organizational change.
  • Track record of developing recruiters — evidence of coaching, mentoring, or managing team members to improved performance outcomes.
US Salary Range
$143,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to .

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Covenant Medical Group is the employed and managed medical practice organization of Covenant Health, providing comprehensive care across East Tennessee. Position Summary:

Analyzes documentation in the medical record to obtain information necessary for the appropriate sequencing and assignment of ICD-10-CM and CPT-4 codes. Abstracts and codes procedures in conjunction with the provider to code services rendered with correct coding initiatives. Abstracts and enters data from the medical records in order to maintain a database for statistics and reporting. Assists the Billing Department in timely billing and rebilling of patient information.

Responsibilities

  • Participates in quality coding and audit reviews for each provider.
  • Assists provider with coding questions for all services rendered.
  • Assists other coders with coding questions to determine the most appropriate codes used for billing compliance and refers coding questions to the Operations Manager when additional research is needed.
  • Contacts physicians for clarification and medical necessity.
  • Reviews all encounters for accurate documentation and coding of services rendered.
  • Communicates pending items and questions with office manager, CDI supervisor, and manager.
  • Demonstrates ability to meet or exceed practice quality and quantity standards.
  • Liaison between practice specialty and insurance company for benefit determination and claim rejections.
  • Follows policies, procedures, and safety standards. Completes required education assignments annually. Works toward achieving goals and objectives, and participates in quality improvement initiatives as requested.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Education:

None specified; will accept any combination of formal education and/or prior work experience sufficient to demonstrate possession of the knowledge, skill and ability needed to perform the essential tasks of the job, typically such as would be equivalent to a high school diploma or GED. Professional coding experience is preferred.

Minimum Experience:

Three (3) years of extensive diagnosis and procedural coding experience required.

Licensure Requirement:

Must have and maintain a CPC coding certification through the American Academy of Professional Coders, or be registered as a Health Information Technician (RHIT) through the American Health Information Management Association.

raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Recruiter to join Codurance and help us attract and hire engineering talent across the UK and Latin America.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone with extensive technical recruitment experience who can operate independently in a structured, established recruitment environment, managing multiple vacancies while maintaining quality, pace and candidate experience.

You will be joining an established recruitment team, so this is not a people management or team leadership position. The focus is on recruitment delivery, ownership and collaboration.

As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you will own the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and recruiter interviews through process management, offer negotiation and onboarding.

You will manage multiple vacancies and candidate pipelines simultaneously, adapting priorities as business needs change while maintaining quality and candidate experience.

A high level of ownership and personal organization is essential. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your workload, making recruitment decisions and keeping processes moving independently.

Requirements

As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you will own the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and recruiter interviews through process management, offer negotiation and onboarding.

You will manage multiple vacancies and candidate pipelines simultaneously, adapting priorities as business needs change while maintaining quality and candidate experience.

A high level of autonomy and personal organization is essential. You should be comfortable taking ownership of your workload, making recruitment decisions and keeping processes moving without requiring close supervision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for multiple technical positions.
  • Manage multiple technical vacancies and candidate pipelines simultaneously while maintaining quality and candidate experience.
  • Recruit experienced Software Engineers across .NET, Java, React, TypeScript, Cloud, DevOps, QA, Platform, Data and AI.
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean Search and other sourcing techniques.
  • Conduct recruiter interviews, assessing technical experience, career progression, motivations and alignment with Codurance's values.
  • Manage candidate pipelines, communication and follow-up throughout the recruitment process.
  • Maintain accurate ATS data, pipeline health and recruitment KPIs, including metrics such as time-to-fill, pipeline conversion and offer acceptance.
  • Identify recruitment bottlenecks and proactively suggest solutions.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, calibrate profiles and maintain alignment throughout the recruitment process.

Required Experience

  • 9+ years of professional recruitment experience, with significant experience in technical recruitment.
  • Strong track record recruiting experienced Software Engineers and other technical engineering profiles across multiple technology stacks.
  • Proven experience managing multiple technical vacancies simultaneously while maintaining quality and candidate experience.
  • Strong sourcing expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean Search and proactive sourcing techniques.
  • Good understanding of modern software engineering roles, technologies and terminology.
  • Experience recruiting across European and/or Latin American markets.
  • Strong candidate and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience conducting structured recruiter interviews.
  • Experience using ATS platforms and recruitment data.
  • Advanced or fluent English, written and spoken.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience recruiting within software consultancies or professional services environments.
  • Experience recruiting contractors or into contract-based technology markets, including familiarity with IR35 where relevant.
  • Understanding of consultancy commercial models, including utilisation, billing or resource planning.
  • Experience contributing to recruitment process improvement or recruitment analytics.

Benefits

Everyone should have the right to bring their whole self to work and be celebrated for who they are. Our people are hired purely on their commitment to these values and their ambition to deliver outstanding results for our clients. Codurance is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

Senior Business Operations Specialist

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based investment management firm building institutional-quality alternative investment solutions for wealth advisors, family offices, and financial professionals. The company combines the innovation and speed of a technology startup with the sophistication of the financial services industry, creating a highly collaborative environment where talented professionals can make a meaningful impact while working directly with senior leadership.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Operations & Investment Operations Specialist to become the operational backbone of a rapidly growing investment management firm.

This is a highly cross-functional role supporting business operations, recruiting, people operations, executive support, investor relations, finance, fund operations, and AI-driven process automation.

The ideal candidate is an experienced operator who thrives in fast-paced startup environments, enjoys building scalable systems, and has a strong understanding of finance, accounting, and investment operations. Rather than simply maintaining processes, you'll continuously improve them through automation and AI while supporting critical business and fund operations.

What You'll Do

Business Operations

  • Manage leadership calendars, meetings, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Support weekly operational reviews and quarterly business planning.

Recruiting & People Operations

Investor Relations & Executive Support

Finance & Fund Operations

  • Review fund reporting and NAV information before leadership approval.
  • Support capital calls, distributions, fee calculations, and investor reporting.
  • Assist with new fund launches and operational setup.
  • Coordinate with external fund administrators and internal finance teams.

AI & Systems Optimization

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve workflows through AI and automation.
  • Build AI-powered workflows, automations, and agents that eliminate manual work.
  • Measure operational improvements through efficiency gains and scalability.

Sales & Marketing Support

  • Support outbound sales initiatives and communication campaigns.
  • Assist with CRM management and business development operations.

Required Qualifications

  • C2 / Near-native English proficiency.
  • 8+ years of experience in Business Operations, Operations, Chief of Staff, Finance Operations, Fund Operations, or similar cross-functional roles.
  • Previous experience working in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, including P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow.
  • Experience supporting finance operations and business processes.
  • Exceptional organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong systems thinking with a continuous improvement mindset.

  • High level of ownership, discretion, and ability to manage confidential information.
  • Comfortable working directly with founders and executive leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in investment management, asset management, capital markets, hedge funds, private equity, venture capital, wealth management, family offices, or fund administration.

Important Notes

raw.description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Full Stack Engineer builds and owns features across YPO’s layered, AI-first platform from the member-facing React experience through the GraphQL API layer, into the AI-powered intelligence and data services that drive personalized leadership insights for YPO’s global member base.

This is a high-ownership, end-to-end role spanning the experience layer (React, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL), API and orchestration (Apigee, Auth0, Redis, Kafka), the AI-powered Leadership Intelligence layer (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Neo4j, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow), systems of record (Salesforce, PostgreSQL), and DevOps/hosting (AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog): taking features from concept through production release, instrumenting them, and iterating on data.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the full feature lifecycle architecture, implementation, code review, QA, deployment, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Build responsive React/TypeScript frontends integrated with Optimizely; design Apollo GraphQL schemas and resolvers served through Apigee; build modular Node.js/NestJS backend services using Redis for caching and Kafka for event-driven workflows.

  • Design and query PostgreSQL schemas (TypeORM/Prisma); collaborate on Snowflake pipelines and dbt models feeding the Leadership Intelligence layer.

  • Integrate OpenAI and Google Gemini APIs for AI-powered discovery, recommendations, and matching; work with Neo4j graph data for relationship-driven insights.

  • Use AI-assisted development workflows (pair programming, code generation, test scaffolding) to increase velocity without compromising quality; handle AI feature failures, timeouts, and token costs with a production mindset.

  • Instrument features with PostHog and Datadog; design and run A/B experiments and feature-flag rollouts via Optimizely; use data to drive iteration.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions, ADRs, and post-incident reviews; address performance bottlenecks across the stack (GraphQL resolvers, N+1 queries, frontend rendering, mobile time-to-interactive).

  • Partner with product, design, the Lead Security Engineer, and DevOps to ensure features are secure, well-architected, and operationally sound from the start.

SKILLS

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-cultural organization with international members, helping them achieve excellence in voluntary roles for YPO initiatives. 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including strong diplomacy skills with the ability to build meaningful relationships with all levels of associates, members and vendors. Adaptable, insightful, empathetic and reliable. Great sense of humor and humility. 

  • Resourceful and able to work independently with initiative and common sense. Effective time management, organization and prioritization skills with the ability to focus on varied projects simultaneously. 

  • Possesses a distinct global mindset, sensitive to local and international customs and protocols.  

  • Demonstrate empathy through active listening and asking the right questions to find the source of an issue. 

  • Able to identify problems, research alternatives, provide solutions and/or resolve issues in a timely manner. Anticipates member/internal client needs and delivers with clarity. 

  • Analytical thinker with ability influence and guide processes with appropriate approach and execution. Natural curiosity and desire to learn more; proficiency and interest in applying new technologies and tools. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proof reading, with a meticulous attention to detail. Adjusts communication style appropriately to the audience.  

  • Professional presence, appearance, and stature to interact easily with YPO members, C-level executives and peers at all levels within the organization.  

EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND

  • 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience shipping production-grade products end-to-end.

  • Strong TypeScript/React skills (component architecture, state management, hooks, performance).

  • Backend experience with Node.js and NestJS building modular, tested services.

  • GraphQL experience (schema design, resolvers, subscriptions, Apollo client/server) and familiarity with API gateway patterns (Apigee or equivalent).

  • PostgreSQL proficiency (query optimization, schema design, TypeORM/Prisma).

  • Experience with Auth0 or equivalent identity platforms.

  • Familiarity with Redis and Kafka (or similar) for caching and event-driven/message-queue patterns.

PREFERED

  • Production experience with OpenAI, Google Gemini, or other LLM APIs (prompt engineering, rate limiting, fallback handling, cost management).

  • Strong architectural thinking and clear technical communication; experience with high-autonomy, end-to-end ownership.

  • Neo4j or other graph database experience.

  • Snowflake/data warehouse experience with dbt or Airflow.

  • Optimizely or similar experimentation/feature-management platforms.

  • Salesforce integration experience.

  • AWS experience (ECS, RDS, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch).

  • Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.

  • Testing with Vitest, Jest, or Playwright (unit, integration, e2e).

EDUCATION/TRAINING/CERTIFICATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work flexible and/or extended hours as needed to accommodate members and team members in multiple time zones.

  • Willingness and ability to travel, domestically and internationally, without restrictions, approximately 5-10% per year.

EOE

YPO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. YPO takes pride in supporting a diverse workforce and demonstrates this through its policies and practices. YPO does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer to provide senior-level systems administration and Azure platform support. This hands-on role is approximately 75% traditional Windows Systems Administration and operational support and 25% troubleshooting and support for a custom Azure-native messaging platform. The ideal contractor is a strong senior systems administrator with deep Microsoft enterprise skills, Azure troubleshooting, scripting and automation experience, strong customer service, and the ability to own complex incidents through resolution. This is not intended to be a pure DevOps platform-engineering role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support Windows Server environments, including configuration, patching, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, security hardening, and operational improvement.
  • Manage Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including hybrid identity, Exchange Hybrid, Microsoft Teams and eDiscovery, users, groups, access controls, and permissions.
  • Administer DNS/Infoblox, SSL/TLS certificates, privileged access functions, enterprise FTP services, file shares, and NTFS permissions.
  • Respond to service requests and incidents, serve as an escalation point for complex infrastructure issues, and support after-hours maintenance, on-call activities, and emergency operations when required.
  • Support and troubleshoot a custom Azure-native messaging solution through log/telemetry analysis, root-cause analysis, configuration review, deployment troubleshooting, and reliability improvements.

  • Use PowerShell, Python, Terraform/Terragrunt, Git/GitHub, C#, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, KQL, and approved AI-assisted engineering tools for automation, infrastructure-as-code, validation, observability, troubleshooting, refactoring, and documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, or enterprise IT operations with demonstrated senior-level technical ownership and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong hands-on Windows Server administration experience in an enterprise environment, including performance, security, patching, troubleshooting, and core infrastructure services.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, hybrid identity, Exchange Hybrid, Microsoft Teams/eDiscovery, DNS, certificate management, access controls, and file permissions.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting and operational automation experience; experience using Python for administration, API checks, validation, reporting, log analysis, or repeatable troubleshooting workflows.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft Azure environments and troubleshooting Azure-hosted applications/services, including platform configuration, deployments, messaging, identity, and monitoring.
  • Working experience with Terraform or Terragrunt and Git/GitHub; strong customer-facing support and cross-team collaboration skills; must be available on-site during emergencies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure Government (AzureUSGovernment), Azure PaaS networking, Azure observability, and integration/message-flow troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read, troubleshoot, and make targeted corrections to C#/.NET and Python code; experience with Kubernetes or containerized workloads is beneficial but not required.
  • Experience leveraging approved generative AI or AI-assisted development tools for DevOps scripting, Terraform/IaC, debugging, root-cause and log/KQL analysis, refactoring, deployment validation, and runbook creation; ability to validate AI-generated output and safeguard credentials and sensitive information.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Windows Server Hybrid Administrator, Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, Azure DevOps Engineer, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience accepted. Operational documentation and runbook experience is also preferred.

Why Contract with Us?

  • Contract is with local government entity
  • Serve in a high-impact senior technical role supporting mission-critical public services across traditional Microsoft enterprise technologies and modern Azure-native services.
  • Support a strategic Azure-hosted messaging platform while strengthening automation, reliability, and troubleshooting capabilities through an independent contractor engagement with competitive hourly compensation.

About the Client

We’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in the Bahamas find an Executive Assistant & Business Operations Specialist to work closely with its Founder & Principal.

The firm supports entrepreneurs, established businesses, institutions, and international clients across a diverse range of professional services, including strategic and financial advisory, corporate services, bookkeeping and accounting, HR and back-office administration, and project management.

This is an opportunity to work directly alongside an experienced business leader and become a trusted right hand across executive support, business operations, financial administration, research, and special projects.

The Role

We’re looking for a highly capable, analytical, and proactive Executive Assistant & Business Operations Specialist who can operate as a genuine extension of the Principal.

This is not a traditional task-based VA role, nor are we looking for a finance specialist. Instead, we need a commercially minded Executive Assistant who is comfortable working across different areas of a business, can quickly understand new concepts, and has the judgment to determine what needs to happen without always waiting for detailed instructions.

You’ll move between executive support, stakeholder communication, light financial administration, research, and operational projects. Strong proficiency with AI tools is also essential—you should know how to use AI intelligently to research, analyze, draft, organize, and improve the way work gets done.

Role Details

Commitment: Part-Time (25 hours/week initially, with potential to increase)

Working Hours: Aligned with Nassau / Eastern Time business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM), with the exact part-time schedule to be agreed

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Rate: $8-12/hour (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

What You’ll Do

Executive & Stakeholder Support

  • Work closely with the Principal on day-to-day executive and business priorities.

  • Manage stakeholder correspondence and ensure important communications receive timely follow-up.

  • Support calendar management, scheduling, meetings, and coordination.

  • Draft, review, organize, and respond to professional emails, documents, reports, and other communications.

  • Track commitments, requests, and action items to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Attend virtual client and prospect meetings alongside the Principal and prepare accurate meeting notes, conclusions, and action items for timely distribution.

  • Support both business and occasional personal executive requirements where needed.

  • Handle sensitive business, financial, and personal information with a high degree of discretion.

Finance & Administrative Support
