raw.description:
Senior Security Engineer

Reports To: Director of Engineering

Summary

AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Senior Security Engineer to own security and compliance across our SaaS platform, the market-leading product powering the home care industry.

This is not a job where you'll write policies that nobody reads. You'll work directly with product engineering teams, embedded in how we build software, shaping our security posture. You'll own engineering's side of our SOC 2 Type II compliance program, lead us toward HITRUST certification, and keep our AWS infrastructure, Docker pipelines, and PHP/React codebase hardened as we move fast.

We're also building AI-powered products on top of Amazon Bedrock and our own machine learning models, and we use AI heavily in how we develop software. That creates new kinds of risk that most security playbooks don't cover yet. We need someone who's thinking about this already and building the guardrails that agents need to write secure software.

Home care agencies trust us to run their business every day. Their data includes protected health information. We need someone who takes that personally.

What You'll Do

Own AxisCare Engineering's security program as an individual contributor. Continually improve our security standards as threats evolve, strengthen the systems that enforce them, and work directly with engineers to close gaps.

Own engineering's share of SOC 2 Type II compliance: control design, evidence collection, audit prep, and gap remediation. Chart the path toward HITRUST certification, mapping what we already have and building what we don't.

Threat-model our application and infrastructure. We run a PHP/React modular monolith on AWS, managed with Terraform, deployed in Docker containers, backed by MySQL in RDS. Raise the bar on this stack's security (IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, container security, database access controls) and keep raising it as the architecture evolves.

Own and improve our security scanning program. Tune findings, cut false positives, and make sure scan results turn into developer action.

Assess and mitigate the security risks inherent in our AI products: prompt injection, data leakage, model output filtering, abuse scenarios. Set guardrails for AI-assisted development workflows so the team ships faster without opening new attack surface.

Strengthen our detection and response capabilities: logging, alerting, incident response playbooks. Coordinate penetration tests, track findings, and drive remediation.

Keep our security policies clear, current, and short. Train developers on secure practices without burying them in process.

What We're Looking For

A builder, not just an auditor. You've built or run a security program inside a product company, not just assessed one from the outside. You can point to systems, controls, and habits you put in place that made a real difference.

A technical peer to engineers. You read code, read Terraform, and talk to developers in their language. When you flag a vulnerability, you can explain the fix, not just the finding.

A pragmatist. You understand that we need to ship. You weigh tradeoffs, probability, and impact, not by saying no to everything.

A strong writer. Remote work demands it, and clear writing is clear thinking. You'll write policies, incident reports, audit narratives, and messages to engineers explaining why something matters. Clarity counts.

An AI-aware security thinker. You're already wrestling with what AI means for security: new attack surfaces, new tooling, new ways that development workflows create risk.

Experience required:

  • 5+ years in application security, infrastructure security, or security engineering at a SaaS company
  • Hands-on experience with AWS security (IAM, VPC, Security Groups, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty)
  • Experience owning or heavily contributing to the engineering side of SOC 2 Type II compliance
  • Familiarity with container security (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
  • Solid grasp of web application security fundamentals (OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC)
  • Experience securing AI/ML systems or LLM-powered products
  • Concrete examples of how you've used AI to improve your own security work: automating compliance tasks, speeding up threat analysis, building detection rules faster, or something we haven't thought of
  • Able to work remotely from the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones
  • Qualified to work in the United States or Canada

What We'd Be Excited to Find

  • Experience building or maintaining HIPAA-compliant or HITRUST-certified environments
  • CISSP, OSCP, or AWS Security Specialty certification
  • Background in penetration testing or red team work

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.

Compensation and Equipment

  • Salary (TBD based on job experience and skill level)
  • Medical insurance is covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment

How to Apply

Apply with a brief resume and either a written or video cover letter.

We review the cover letter before anything else in your application, so this really matters. This is your single biggest opportunity to improve your chances, and video submissions go right to the front of the line.

Prompt: How has AI changed the security landscape you work in: what's gotten easier, what's gotten harder, and how have you adapted? Tell us about a security program, control, or hard problem you're proud of owning. Tell us why this position is the one you've been hoping to find.

Written: No more than 600 words. We're looking for clarity of thought and strong communication. Use AI if you want, but don't send slop.

Video: 1–2 minutes, linked in the "Website, Blog, or Portfolio" section of your application. Doesn't need to be highly produced. We care about how you think and communicate.

We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds and every walk of life to apply. Every person on our team brings their own unique perspective, and it's what makes our products better and our work more rewarding. We're eager to support you so that you can ship work you're proud of.

Candidates only. No recruiters, please.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more user-friendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 6 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

Accenture's Consumer Goods & Services practice helps the world's leading brands reinvent how they grow, compete, and operate. We work with food and beverage, beauty and personal care, household products, consumer health, pet care, and agribusiness clients at the intersection of enterprise strategy, commercial growth, operating model reinvention, M&A and integration, and AI-enabled decision making. We combine industry depth with strategy, technology, operations, data, and talent capabilities to turn CEO-level priorities into measurable revenue, margin, and enterprise-value outcomes.

You Are

A senior strategy leader who combines top-tier consulting experience with senior operating experience building and scaling growth engines. You have led enterprise growth strategy, portfolio and business model decisions, commercial and operating model transformations, and M&A or integration agendas. You understand consumer brands, product and innovation economics, customer and consumer needs, and how growth choices translate into execution across marketing, sales, operations, technology, and talent. You are comfortable advising CEOs and executive teams, shaping an ambiguous question into a fact-based value case and actionable roadmap, and staying accountable through execution. You can originate work, mobilize cross-functional teams, and develop leaders while maintaining high standards for quality and commercial outcomes.

The Work

As an Associate Director, you will lead CEO- and C-suite-level strategy and reinvention engagements for Consumer Goods clients. You will shape and sell work, lead multi-workstream delivery, and help clients convert growth, portfolio, integration, and operating-model priorities into measurable results.

Executive and Engagement Leadership

  • Lead large, complex strategy and enterprise-reinvention programs with multiple concurrent workstreams and senior stakeholder groups.
  • Own relationships with client CEOs, business-unit presidents, CFOs, CMOs, Chief Sales Officers, COOs, CSCOs, and strategy or corporate-development leaders.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams spanning strategy, finance and value, commercial, operations, data and AI, technology, talent, and change management.
  • Ensure engagement quality, timeliness, financial performance, and risk management; resolve escalations and maintain alignment across differing stakeholder perspectives.

Growth Strategy and Enterprise Reinvention

  • Define enterprise and business-unit growth strategies, market and category choices, portfolio priorities, and business-model options.
  • Build growth engines spanning consumer and customer strategy, brand and innovation, commercial excellence, pricing and revenue growth management, route-to-market, partnerships, and new ventures.
  • Design operating models, decision rights, governance, organization structures, capabilities, and performance-management systems required to execute the strategy.
  • Develop fact-based value cases, scenario models, revenue and margin bridges, investment priorities, and benefit-realization plans.
  • Shape reinvention programs around Accenture's Consumer Goods priorities, including the Enterprise Performance Engine, Connected Sales Reinvention, and Insight-to-Launch.
  • Apply sub-industry nuance across food and beverage, beauty and personal care, household products, consumer health, pet care, and agribusiness to tailor recommendations to client-specific economics and routes to market.

M&A, Integration, and Portfolio Transformation

  • Advise clients on strategic alternatives, portfolio reshaping, partnerships, acquisitions, divestitures, and inorganic-growth priorities.
  • Lead integration strategy, growth-synergy identification, Day 1 and Day 2 operating-model design, and value-capture planning.
  • Protect brand, customer, and talent momentum while integrating commercial, operational, technology, and corporate capabilities.
  • Establish integration governance, decision forums, metrics, and value-tracking mechanisms that connect transaction logic to realized outcomes.

AI, Data, and Digital Growth Enablement

  • Identify where AI, analytics, and data can unlock growth, improve decision quality, accelerate innovation, and increase enterprise productivity.
  • Translate priority use cases into the process, operating-model, data, technology, governance, and workforce changes required for enterprise adoption.
  • Use GenAI and agentic tools to accelerate research, consumer and customer insight, strategy development, scenario planning, and executive decision support.
  • Partner with AI, data, technology, and ecosystem teams to move solutions from proof of concept to scaled business impact with responsible-AI controls.

Business Development and Practice Growth

  • Originate and shape Consumer Goods strategy and reinvention opportunities, including C-suite sessions, proposals, solution architectures, value cases, and commercial models.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop managers and consultants; contribute to recruiting, staffing, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Support account planning and pipeline development across priority North American Consumer Goods clients.

Principal Directors have:

  • Executive presence and the ability to lead fact-based, decision-oriented discussions with C-suite and Board-level stakeholders.
  • Deep capability in enterprise and growth strategy, commercial strategy, operating-model design, portfolio choices, and value creation.
  • Ability to lead large, multi-workstream programs and mobilize cross-functional teams across strategy, technology, operations, and talent.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, professional services, or an equivalent internal corporate-strategy role.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in one or more of the following: enterprise or growth strategy, corporate development, commercial strategy, business-model design, M&A and integration, or operating-model transformation.

At ForgeOS, our mission is to develop and deliver the technology, tools, talent, and insight required to make a demonstrable positive impact on the bottom line for telecom partners and their customers. With over 50 years of collective technology, partner channel, and industry experience, ForgeOS delivers automation and expertise designed to unravel the complexity of the telecom market.

The Commissions Analyst is a partner facing position that owns end-to-end commissions service delivery for the assigned partner portfolio. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and exceptional attention to detail. This position reports to the Director of Revenue Operations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Conduct thorough analyses of carrier commission reports to ensure accuracy and timely processing.
  • Process partner commission statements using internal commissions software.
  • Communicate the results of monthly reconciliations to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Audit order submissions with TSD/suppliers and ensure all commission requirements are in place.
  • Perform ad-hoc analyses and audits, including order tagging, wireless line activations, and commissioning account numbers.
  • Perform software QA testing on commissions features in internal software per documented process; flag issues to the Director.
  • Act as backup for other commissions analysts when needed.
  • Own end-to-end commissions service delivery for assigned external partners: serve as primary operational contact for that portfolio from intake through resolution per documented process. Backup and PTO handoff are governed by team SOP.
  • Establish meaningful relationships across the assigned partner portfolio through consistent and reliable communication.
  • Lead monthly partner commission review meetings and participate in cadence calls as needed; review status with partners and surface issues that need attention.
  • Assist assigned partners with ongoing questions about commissions OS features that come up during status reviews and routine work.
  • Escalate with context to the Senior Commissions Analyst when an issue exceeds routine resolution.
  • Other Duties: Other projects and assignments as needed, including special analyses and data validation.
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Minimum 2 years' experience in the telecom channel, with direct commissions experience, required.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience required.
  • Working knowledge of tiered commission structures and complex payment configurations.
  • Ability to interpret contracts and extract commission-related information, including payment breakdowns and dispute timelines.
  • Ability to summarize analyses clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong commitment to customer service, with the ability to anticipate and meet partner needs.
  • Ability to work independently with limited oversight and to prioritize effectively during peak cycles (including month-end).
  • Advanced technical skills in Microsoft Excel, including filtering large data sets, navigating large spreadsheets, using functions such as SUM and ROUND, leveraging Pivot Tables, and utilizing VLOOKUP efficiently.
  • Comfort exercising new software features against documented expectations and reporting reproducible defects.
  • Experience with commissions management and telco/channel tools (e.g. RPM Telco) is preferred but not required.
  • Prior experience as a primary point of contact for external partners or customers is preferred but not required.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer.
  • Must be able to read, write, and speak English proficiently.

The remotePost-Sales Security Systems Engineer is the technical architect of project execution. Following the sales phase, you will own the "Technical Truth" of a project—transforming preliminary designs into precise, executable installation packages. Technical Execution & Design

  • System Implementation: Design and develop engineering solutions for complex system installations, upgrades, and enterprise-level conversions.

Innovation & Strategy

  • Technology Adoption: Support management in documenting and implementing "Next-Gen" tech (Biometrics, Radar, Anti-Drone) for existing and new clients.

  • Ability to manage time and multiple tasks without supervision.

OCT is looking for an Integrated Master Scheduler to support a major federal level policy initiative. The initiative impacts national security and effects all of the U.S. government and a large portion of the U.S. industrial base. It managed and governed via a comprehensive Integrated Master Schedule and other tools.

Role:

  • Maintain, update and as required, re-baseline the Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) for the federal government.
  • Apply project management principles to manage, monitor, update, integrate and improve the IMS, incorporating major program milestones. Aggressively manage IMS critical path and near critical path in close coordination with government stakeholders.
  • Perform program schedule analysis, including assessing critical path, near critical path, bottlenecks, inter-dependencies, float, slack and schedule variance to ensure project timelines are met, making recommendations for improvement to government personnel.
  • Use schedule data to maintain and propose schedule metrics in PowerBi generated management dashboards, executive level briefings and reports.
  • Maintain risk and bottleneck repository.
  • Maintain IMS, ensuring it reflects all key milestones and deliverables, and accurately tracks progress against planned schedules.
  • Monitor vendor schedule performance, analyzing weekly and monthly variances to ensure adherence to project timelines and address any discrepancies.
  • Utilize project management techniques such as Gantt charts, PERT charts, milestone charts, and earned value management to gauge project progress and identify performance variances.
  • Assess overall health of IMS in accordance with government best practices, providing recommendations for improvement as possible.
  • Lead and manage Schedule Integrated Product Team (IPT) and participate in affiliated IPTS and governance forums.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in scheduling, providing mentorship and guidance to government officials on scheduling best practices and techniques.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with enterprise-level scheduling software, leveraging its features to enhance schedule management and integration.
  • Propose and implement processes to improve integrated scheduling and enhance overall project management efficiency.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • At least eight (8) years of experience with federal government acquisitions integrated project planning.
  • Proven experience in designing, developing, and maintaining Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) for complex projects.
  • Skilled in performing program schedule analysis, including evaluating metrics, critical path, float, and schedule variance.
  • Experience in building and maintaining a program-level IMS, monitoring vendor performance, and utilizing various project management techniques.
  • Expertise in using enterprise-level scheduling software and proposing processes to improve integrated scheduling.
  • Ability to act as a scheduling subject matter expert and mentor program staff in best practices and effective scheduling techniques.
  • Must be a US Citizen.
  • Must possess an active and current DoD Secret Clearance.

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Retirement savings 401K plan provided by an industry leading provider with 3% employer contributions of the employee’s gross salary
  • Paid Time Off and Standard Government Holidays
  • Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term disability benefits
  • Training Benefits

OCT Consulting LLC is a certified SBA 8(a), minority owned, small, disadvantaged business providing professional services and Information Technology solutions to the federal government and commercial clients. We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session

  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

We're growing, and we're looking for people who share that conviction. If you're ready to be part of a pharmacy that takes the work seriously and the people even more seriously, we'd like to meet you.

Mission:

Strive exists to disrupt an industry long overdue for a more personal approach to care. We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. We're a team on a mission to change what personalized healthcare looks and feels like.

Position Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote (US)

Position Overview:

As an Account Executive (AE) for Strive Compounding Pharmacy’s Partnerships team, you will be responsible for expanding and managing enterprise and key strategic accounts, driving revenue growth, and building strong relationships with executives and c-suites. Your primary goal is to ensure these partnerships thrive while delivering tailored solutions that meet their unique needs. You will also self source new Partners to ensure a strong pipeline and also help Strive thrive in new markets. This position requires someone with strong communication, consultative selling skills, and a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Account Management & Growth:
    • Develop and maintain relationships with existing clients, ensuring ongoing satisfaction and identifying opportunities for upselling.
    • Drive business growth through new account acquisition and expanding the service offerings within existing accounts.

  • Consultative Sales:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to business owners, c-suites and top level executives. Understanding their needs, educating them on Strive’s products, and providing custom compounding pharmacy solutions.
    • Present product offerings and demonstrate value, focusing on how Strive’s services can improve patient care as well as scale their business.
  • Client Onboarding & Training:
    • Lead the onboarding process for new accounts, ensuring smooth integration with Strive’s services.
    • Provide training on Strive’s products and pharmacy services to new partners and continuously support their needs.
  • Market Insights & Feedback:
    • Stay informed about market trends, the competitive landscape, and new innovations in the industry.
    • Collect and relay client feedback to internal teams to help shape product and service enhancements.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4 years in an account management or sales role working with enterprise customers. [Preferred experience in pharmaceutical]
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work independently and meet sales targets.
  • Experience with CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.) for tracking sales performance and client interactions.
  • Experience and confidence in sourcing and closing new leads.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong understanding of the telehealth industry and compounding pharmacy services.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to navigate complex client needs.

Work Environment:

This position is primarily based in a remote work environment. The role requires regular periods of sitting, standing, and computer use, with occasional lifting as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

Join Us in Making an Impact:

At Strive, the work is real and the impact is direct. Every role here contributes to a patient experience that's more personal, more attentive, and more human than what most people have come to expect from a pharmacy. Apply today and help us raise the bar.

We're committed to supporting the personal and professional growth of every employee, inside and outside the workplace.

raw.title: Junior Quantitative Researcher (Fresh STEM PhD graduates are welcome)
raw.excerpt: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users.
raw.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

We are building out a new research function at the intersection of artificial intelligence and quantitative trading to improve the efficiency of execution algo models and more, and we are looking for a Junior Quantitative Researcher to be a founding member of this effort. You will work alongside senior quants, engineers, and traders to design AI-driven workflows that generate alpha signals, diagnose model and PnL behavior, and deepen our understanding of market microstructure.

This is a high-ownership role suited to someone who is genuinely excited about markets, has a strong research background, and is already building with modern AI tooling — including LLM-based agents. We are open to hiring at the fresh-PhD level, provided you can demonstrate research depth and a real interest in trading.

Responsibilities

  • Signal research and construction. Develop, test, and productionize predictive signals across asset classes using a combination of statistical methods, machine learning, and AI agent–driven research workflows. Take ideas from hypothesis through backtest, validation, and deployment.

  • Root cause analysis (RCA). Investigate model behavior, signal decay, PnL attribution, and unexpected trading outcomes. Build tools — including agentic ones — that accelerate diagnosis and shorten the loop between observation and fix.

  • Market microstructure research. Study order book dynamics, execution costs, liquidity, and venue behavior to inform both signal design and execution strategy.

  • AI agent infrastructure for research. Help design and extend internal agentic systems that automate parts of the research pipeline — data exploration, hypothesis generation, backtest configuration, results summarization, and report drafting.

  • Collaborate broadly. Work closely with traders, engineers, and other researchers to turn ideas into live, monitored strategies.

Requirements

    • PhD (recently completed or near completion) in a quantitative field — e.g., Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Operations Research, or a related discipline.

    • Strong programming skills in Python; comfortable with the modern data and ML stack (NumPy, pandas, PyTorch or JAX, etc.).

    • Hands-on experience building with AI agents and LLM-based systems — for example, tool-using agents, multi-step reasoning pipelines, retrieval systems, or evaluation frameworks. We want to see that you have actually built things, not just read papers.

    • Solid grounding in statistics, probability, and machine learning, with the rigor to know when a result is real and when it isn't.

    • Genuine interest in financial markets and trading, demonstrable through coursework, personal projects, competitions, internships, or self-directed study.

    • Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical work clearly to a mixed audience.

Nice to Have

    • Prior internship or research experience at a hedge fund, prop trading firm, market maker, bank, or fintech.

    • Exposure to market microstructure, limit order books, or high-frequency data.

    • Experience with backtesting frameworks, time-series analysis, or causal inference.

    • Familiarity with low-latency systems, or large-scale data infrastructure.

    • Publications, open-source contributions, or trading competition results.

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
Join our Product team as a Senior Product Manager and play a critical role in advancing accessible digital experiences at enterprise scale. You will own and develop a core product domain within the Level Access platform. You will get results across several squads and help invent how we build and deliver AI-powered products.

This position suits a senior-level PM who works well with strategy execution, systems thinking, and AI-enabled product development. You will focus on customer impact and improving product excellence throughout the organization.

Mission of the Role

You will be accountable for defining, refining, and implementing a key product strategy area focused on helping customers efficiently improve and maintain digital accessibility within live, production environments.

This includes translating strategic intent into executable plans, validating direction through customer and market signals, and evolving solutions over time as user needs, platform capabilities, and AI technologies advance.

In parallel, you will serve as a role model and thought partner within the product organization:

  • AI-powered product discovery and delivery methods
  • High‑rigor experimentation and decision‑making
  • Scalable, results-focused product delivery

Core Responsibilities

Strategy Ownership & Execution

  • Be responsible for a significant product area and drive execution against a defined strategy, ensuring alignment with company objectives and long‑term platform direction.
  • Continuously refine strategy based on customer insight, data, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities.
  • Translate strategy into clear multi‑quarter roadmaps, investment trade‑offs, and success metrics.
  • Drive alignment across product, engineering, data science, design, and go‑to‑market teams.

AI‑Native Product Leadership

  • Lead product discovery and delivery using AI‑enabled workflows (e.g., rapid prototyping, automation‑assisted analysis, iterative improvements).
  • Partner closely with engineering and data science teams to deliver AI‑powered customer experiences, from early concepts through production and iteration.
  • Ensure AI‑driven features are trustworthy, measurable, and meaningfully improve user and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to shared standards for responsibly shipping AI capabilities in enterprise software.

Product Ownership & Multi‑Squad Delivery

  • Serve as the product manager across one or more squads, accountable for outcomes rather than output.
  • Drive complex initiatives from discovery through general availability, leading dependencies and cross‑team coordination.
  • Balance innovation with platform quality, scalability, and technical debt considerations.
  • Ensure strong product quality through clear requirements, testing alignment, and post‑launch validation.

Customer, Market & Insight Leadership

  • Maintain a deep understanding of customer workflows, difficulties, and success criteria particularly within enterprise environments.
  • Engage directly with customers to validate problems, test solutions, and refine value propositions.
  • Stay informed on digital accessibility standards and regulatory trends and how they intersect with modern enterprise technology.
  • Monitor market and competitive signals and proactively adapt product direction.

Team & Org Impact

  • Model Senior PM behaviors and expectations across:
  • Critical thinking and execution
  • Data fluency and insight generation
  • Technical depth and system understanding
  • User empathy and evidence‑based decision‑making
  • Mentor and influence other PMs through thought partnership, feedback, and example.
  • Act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, clearly articulating trade‑offs, risks, and rationale.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with shown success operating at a Senior PM level.
  • Experience owning strategy and execution for complex platform or SaaS products.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver outcomes across multiple squads or large product areas.
  • Strong technical fluency, including a working understanding of modern web technologies and system architecture.
  • Experience contributing to or shipping AI‑enabled or data‑driven product features.
  • High data literacy, including defining success metrics, running experiments, and tying decisions to business outcomes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience working in an environment using AI‑enabled product discovery and delivery practices.
  • Experience building products for enterprise, developer, or technically sophisticated users.
  • Familiarity with digital accessibility standards and conformance workflows.
  • Comfort driving alignment and decision‑making across disciplines without direct authority.

Nice to Have

  • Background in software engineering, QA automation, or data‑oriented roles.
  • Experience building tools that support remediation, compliance, or continuous improvement workflows.
  • Knowledge of evolving digital accessibility regulations and standards.
  • Experience designing for diverse personas and inclusive user experiences.

How This Role Operates at a Senior PM Level

This role is designed for someone who:

  • Drives strategy and execution with minimal guidance
  • Owns outcomes across squads and initiatives
  • Is a go‑to expert for their product domain
  • Uses data, user insight, and technical judgment fluently
  • Raises the performance bar for the broader product team
  • Ships high‑quality products that deliver measurable customer and business impact

Application Process

If you thrive in a fast‑paced environment and you are eager to make a significant impact in the field of accessibility, we would love to hear from you! This is a full‑time, salaried position offering a competitive benefits package, including bonus opportunities, generous paid time off, paid holidays, and a range of programs designed to support employee well‑being and work‑life balance. Interested in immediate consideration? Please submit your resume to be considered for this role.

Level Access uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance our recruitment and hiring processes. These tools may assist with activities such as résumé screening, skills assessments, interview scheduling, and communication. These tools are designed to assist our recruiters and do not make final hiring decisions. The role contributes to continuous improvement by translating process changes into practical business implications, consolidating regional feedback, escalating key concerns or recommendations, and assessing local or regional regulatory and operational impacts on global processes. In addition, the incumbent may act as Global Process Owner for assigned documents, lead review and approval workflows, contribute to process-related training strategy and materials, and mentor selected Associate Directors to support capability development and consistent process leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive the execution of global clinical process management activities within GCO, ensuring processes and standards are efficient, consistent, sustainable, and compliant with applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Serve as the primary GCOE point of contact for one or more assigned GCO processes, including related SOPs, work instructions, and standards.
  • Contribute to the development of GCO procedural content in collaboration with Global Process Owners and Subject Matter Experts and may act as Global Process Owner for assigned documents, including SOPs, work instructions, templates, and tools.
  • Lead GCO process management initiatives, assessing the need to revise or create controlled documents and supporting continuous improvement, change management, and effective implementation.

  • Act as advisor and reviewer for processes owned by other functions that impact GCO processes, standards, and ways of working.
  • Establish and maintain effective partnerships with relevant GCO teams and cross-functional stakeholders, including GCP Compliance, Learning and Development, and other groups as required.
  • Contribute to the development, strategy, and implementation of training materials related to GCO processes.
  • Serve as the primary communication liaison between GCO Regional Heads, their organizations, and the GCPM team for processes under development or revision.
  • Support effective adoption of new or revised processes by translating process changes into practical business implications for regional and local teams.
  • Partner with Regional Head organizations to consolidate feedback, promote alignment, and support a coordinated regional perspective on process adoption.
  • Escalate regional positioning, concerns, or recommendations to the Head of GCPM and the relevant GCPM Process Lead to enable appropriate follow-up, decision-making, and collaborative resolution.
  • Relay key local and regional insights, including changes in local regulations or operational requirements, to assess and address potential impacts on global processes within GCPM scope.

  • Experience working in matrix environment and in global teams
  • Excellent interpersonal, problem-solving, negotiation and conflict resolution skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and a pre-disposition to quality management and process improvement

As a Senior Integration Engineer for Tokenization, your mission at Marqeta will be to serve as a trusted technical and payments advisor for Marqeta's customers, digging in to provide solutions throughout the customer tokenization life cycle — enabling cardholders to provision payment cards to Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay across mobile and web surfaces. While this role focuses primarily on tokenization APIs, a working knowledge of the core platform — Cards, Users, and Card Products — will greatly improve your chances of success.

You will be on the front line communicating directly with customers (particularly our customer’s developers, product owners, and project managers) and you will partner with groups within Marqeta’s organization.

We work Flexible First. This role can be performed remotely in the United States, only in one of our Premium or National locations, which you can review here.

The Impact You’ll Have

  • Ensure key technical stakeholders at customers and prospects deeply understand our platform, what sets it apart, and how to get integrated and live quickly
  • Own the technical implementation of customers onto our platform, including technical advisement, environment configuration, and troubleshooting
  • Become an expert on Marqeta's tokenization APIs, developing and sharing best practices for deploying them

raw.description:
Perforce is a community of collaborative experts, problem solvers, and possibility seekers who believe work should be both challenging and fun. We are proud to inspire creativity, foster belonging, support collaboration, and encourage wellness. At Perforce, you’ll work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in business. Before you know it, you’ll be in the middle of a rewarding career at a company headed in one direction: upward.
 
With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce. 

Perforce is hiring a Senior Compensation Analyst to serve as the dedicated owner of CaptivateIQ (CIQ), our commissions and incentive compensation platform. This role sits at the center of sales compensation operations, responsible for the day-to-day accuracy of commission calculations, the integrity of plan configurations, and the ongoing evolution of the system as Perforce's comp plans, deal structures, and go-to-market strategy change.

This is not a general comp analyst role. We need someone who has lived inside CaptivateIQ, who understands its data model, calculation logic, statement generation, and admin console at a deep, technical level, and who can be trusted as the final word on how the system should be configured and why.

Why Perforce

You'll have real ownership of a system that directly impacts how our sales organization is paid — with the autonomy to shape how CIQ evolves as Perforce grows. You'll work closely with FP&A, Sales Operations, and Sales leadership on high-visibility initiatives, including compensation plan redesign and dependent-variable incentive structures.

What You'll Do:

    Own CaptivateIQ end-to-end: serve as the primary system administrator responsible for configuration, data integrity, calculation logic, and platform governance.

    Update, correct, and maintain commission plan structures, rules, tiers, accelerators, and crediting logic within CIQ as plans change or errors are identified.

    Investigate and resolve commission calculation discrepancies, tracing issues back to source data (Salesforce, HRIS, billing) versus CIQ configuration.

    Act as the go-to recommender for all CIQ changes; evaluating requests from Sales, Sales Ops, HR, and Finance, and advising on the best way to implement them within the platform's capabilities.

    Partner with FP&A and Sales Compensation leadership to translate new or amended comp plans (including dependent-variable and accelerator-based designs) into accurate CIQ builds.

    Manage data integrations and imports between CIQ and upstream systems (Salesforce, HRIS, billing/ERP), ensuring clean, reconciled data flows.

    Build and maintain CIQ reporting and dashboards to support commission audits, payout reconciliation, and leadership visibility into plan performance.

    Own the commission payout calendar and monthly/quarterly close process within CIQ, ensuring statements are accurate and released on time.

    Document CIQ configurations, workflows, and change history to maintain a clean audit trail and reduce key-person risk.

    Support SOX-related controls and audit requests tied to commission calculations and system access.

    Train and support sales, finance, and HR stakeholders on how to read commission statements and use CIQ-related tools.

    Stay current on CaptivateIQ platform releases and proactively recommend enhancements that improve accuracy, scalability, or rep experience.

What You Bring:

    5+ years of experience in sales compensation, commissions administration, or a related finance/RevOps function.

    Deep, hands-on CaptivateIQ experience is required; including plan building, formula/logic configuration, data connections, and admin-level troubleshooting. Candidates without direct CIQ experience will not be considered.

    Proven track record as a system owner or lead administrator for a commissions or incentive compensation platform (CIQ, Xactly, Varicent, SPIFF, or similar), with a strong preference for CaptivateIQ specifically.

    Strong understanding of sales compensation plan mechanics such as quotas, accelerators, tiers, SPIFFs, draws, clawbacks, and multi-component plans.

    Advanced Excel skills; comfort working with large, imperfect datasets and reconciling data across systems.

    Experience with Salesforce (or another CRM) as a data source for commissions, including how opportunity and product data flow into calculations.

    Excellent attention to detail and a bias toward accuracy; this role is the last line of defense before commission dollars go out the door.

    Strong communication skills; able to explain complex calculation logic clearly to non-technical stakeholders and to push back diplomatically on requests that would compromise data integrity.

    Comfort operating independently and taking ownership; this person will be the internal expert and primary decision-maker on CIQ matters.

Nice to Have:

    CaptivateIQ certification or formal admin training.

    Experience supporting compensation plans in a PE-backed or multi-business-unit software company.

    Familiarity with ASC 606 revenue recognition as it relates to commission expensing.

YOU BRING THESE SKILLS

raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team!

You will own and evolve Mailtrap's production infrastructure — a multi-region AWS platform powering high-volume email sending and testing. You will keep it reliable, secure, and cost-efficient day to day.

You will also lead a key strategic initiative: planning and executing a partial migration of selected workloads from AWS to rented bare-metal / colocation infrastructure to cut costs — a hybrid-by-design effort, not a full cloud exit.

You will decide what moves and what stays, design the target platform (likely Kubernetes or a similar orchestrator on bare metal), and own the migration end to end, from business case to cutover.

Our engineering team thrives in an agile, continuously improving, and automation-oriented environment. We value ongoing evolution, objective evaluation of our processes, and taking action to make things better.

Must have skills

  • 5+ years DevOps/platform (senior), production ownership
  • Deep AWS (VPC, ECS, IAM, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents, networking)
  • Terraform at scale (modules, remote state / Terraform Cloud)
  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions, including automated deploys to production (e.g. blue/green deployments)
  • Containers (Docker); comfortable operating services on ECS or K8s
  • Strong Linux networking (DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls, VPN/hybrid)
  • Proven experience planning and executing migration to on-prem, colo, or private cloud (partial/hybrid OK — full exit not required)
  • Comfortable owning a multi-quarter infra initiative: TCO, design, vendors, cutover, rollback
  • Comfortable automating operational tasks with shell and/or Python
  • Fluent English (both spoken and written)

Strongly preferred

  • Colo/bare-metal ops: IPAM (NetBox), Ansible, image-based provisioning (Packer or equivalent), HAProxy/Nginx
  • Replacing managed AWS services with self-hosted (Postgres HA, Redis/Valkey, Kafka, OpenSearch)
  • Email infrastructure (MTA, SMTP, IP reputation, DKIM/SPF/DMARC) — Halon or similar
  • Cloudflare (DNS/WAF/Access)
  • Observability beyond CloudWatch (Prometheus/Grafana/Loki or equivalent)
  • Prior work with multi-region SaaS or EU data residency
  • Cost-driven architecture / FinOps mindset

Would be a plus

  • GCP (BigQuery/certificates)
  • Comfortable reading Ruby or Go (used in our services and tooling)
  • AWS Certificates

Responsibilities day-to-day

  • Operate and evolve AWS multi-account / multi-region infra
  • Terraform modules/workspaces
  • Ensure safe infrastructure changes across network, storage, and services, with zero-downtime deployments.
  • ECS services, blue/green deploys, Docker image pipelines
  • Reliability: CloudWatch/PagerDuty/Sentry, capacity, cost tags
  • Security baseline: IAM, secrets (SSM), Cloudflare edge rules
  • Partner with engineers on release automation and production readiness
  • Maintain the hybrid estate (AWS and rented bare metal) as one operable platform

Migration leadership

  • Build the business and technical case for what moves off AWS vs what stays
  • Design the rented bare-metal / colo landing zone (compute, network, storage, observability, secrets)
  • Produce migration waves, dependency maps, cutover/rollback plans
  • Stand up hybrid connectivity and dual-run periods; shift traffic safely (e.g. via Cloudflare)
  • Replace or re-home managed services where it pays off (compute, queues, search, cache, MTA nodes)
  • Coordinate colo/vendors, timelines, and eng teams; report progress and risk

● Train to Be the Best: Extensive initial and ongoing training, courses, and professional development designed to help you become exceptionally strong at what you do.

● A Workspace That Feels Alive: Our remote environment is designed to keep the team connected, collaborative, and engaged even when we're working from different parts of the world.

● Quarterly Town Halls: Regular company-wide updates so you understand what is happening across the business and where we are heading.

● The Dream-On Program: Our CEO grants multiple wishes each year pulled directly from team members' dream boards.

● 25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because great work requires time to recharge and have a life outside work.

● Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days each year to volunteer with a charity of your choice.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will understand our creative standards, clients, workflows, and brand requirements and begin taking full ownership of your design projects.

Ongoing, you will be measured on:

● Creative Quality: Consistently producing polished, original, high-quality creative that meets or exceeds professional agency standards.

● Creative Ownership: Taking projects from initial concept through final delivery with minimal supervision and strong judgment at every stage.

● Brand Consistency: Ensuring every asset reflects the client's brand, audience, positioning, and campaign objectives.

● Strategic Design: Creating visuals that do more than look good — they communicate clearly, support marketing objectives, and contribute to measurable campaign outcomes.

● Speed & Reliability: Managing multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing quality or allowing important details to slip through the cracks.

● Attention to Detail: Catching inconsistencies, errors, spacing issues, formatting problems, and other details before work reaches the client.

● Collaboration: Working effectively with marketers, strategists, copywriters, account managers, and other creative team members to produce stronger work.

● Client Impact: Creating work that clients value, approve confidently, and can use effectively across their marketing.

A Typical Week Might Include

● Reviewing creative briefs and marketing objectives before translating them into visual concepts.

● Developing concepts, layouts, graphics, advertisements, social media creative, presentations, and other marketing assets.

● Taking a project from rough concept through design, revision, approval, and final delivery.

● Collaborating with Account Managers, Marketing Strategists, copywriters, and other internal specialists.

● Reviewing existing client creative and identifying opportunities to improve visual consistency and effectiveness.

● Managing multiple projects simultaneously while prioritizing deadlines and maintaining quality.

● Presenting creative concepts and explaining the strategic thinking behind your design decisions.

● Responding to feedback, refining creative, and knowing when to push an idea further versus when to move forward.

● Staying current with design trends, creative technology, AI tools, and evolving visual communication practices.

Key Competencies

● Creative Thinker: You generate original ideas rather than simply replicating what already exists.

● Exceptional Attention to Detail: You notice the small things that separate good design from outstanding design.

● Strategic Designer: You understand that design needs to serve an audience, communicate a message, and support a business objective.

● High Standards: You hold your own work to a professional standard and are not satisfied with "good enough."

● Excellent Communicator: You can explain creative decisions clearly and confidently to both internal teammates and professional clients.

● Problem Solver: You can work through unclear briefs, creative challenges, competing priorities, and tight deadlines without becoming stuck.

● Adaptable: You can move between different brands, industries, audiences, and creative requirements without losing quality.

● Time Management Master: You know how to manage your workload, prioritize competing deadlines, and deliver consistently.

● Collaborative: You know when to lead creatively, when to listen, and how to make the people around you better.

● Resilient & Self-Confident: You are comfortable receiving feedback, defending a strong creative idea when appropriate, and continually improving your work.

This Role Is Not for You If

● You need someone to give you exact instructions for every design decision.

● You are primarily interested in making things look attractive without considering the marketing objective behind them.

● You struggle to manage multiple projects or deadlines simultaneously.

● You take creative feedback personally or resist revisions.

● You regularly miss small details that affect the quality of finished work.

● You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving agency environment where priorities can change.

● You need constant supervision to stay productive.

● You are not interested in continuing to develop your creative skills and staying current with new design tools and trends.

Skills and Experience Required

● 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong track record of producing commercial, marketing-focused creative in an agency, in-house marketing, advertising, or similarly fast-paced environment.

● A strong portfolio demonstrating high-level commercial and marketing design work across multiple formats and industries.

● Thorough understanding of graphic design principles, including typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, colour, visual storytelling, and brand consistency.

● Demonstrated ability to take a project from concept through final execution.

● Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

● Strong understanding of designing for digital marketing, including social media, paid advertising, web, email, and other digital channels.

● Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

● Strong attention to detail and quality control.

● A reliable remote work setup and ability to work independently.

Preferred Skills and Experience

● Previous experience working in a digital marketing or creative agency.

● Experience designing creative specifically for paid advertising and conversion-focused campaigns.

● Experience working across multiple client brands simultaneously.

● Experience with motion graphics, video editing, animation, or other multimedia design.

● Experience with Figma, Canva, or similar collaborative design platforms.

● Familiarity with AI-assisted creative and design tools.

● Experience designing for childcare, education, franchise, healthcare, or other multi-location businesses.

● Experience presenting creative concepts to clients or senior stakeholders.

● Understanding of marketing performance and how creativity can influence engagement, conversion, and acquisition.

Work Environment

This is a full-time, remote-first position.

About Childcare Marketing Group

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow with smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team!

You will own and evolve Mailtrap's production infrastructure — a multi-region AWS platform powering high-volume email sending and testing. You will keep it reliable, secure, and cost-efficient day to day.

You will also lead a key strategic initiative: planning and executing a partial migration of selected workloads from AWS to rented bare-metal / colocation infrastructure to cut costs — a hybrid-by-design effort, not a full cloud exit.

You will decide what moves and what stays, design the target platform (likely Kubernetes or a similar orchestrator on bare metal), and own the migration end to end, from business case to cutover.

Our engineering team thrives in an agile, continuously improving, and automation-oriented environment. We value ongoing evolution, objective evaluation of our processes, and taking action to make things better.

Must have skills

  • 5+ years DevOps/platform (senior), production ownership
  • Deep AWS (VPC, ECS, IAM, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents, networking)
  • Terraform at scale (modules, remote state / Terraform Cloud)
  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions, including automated deploys to production (e.g. blue/green deployments)
  • Containers (Docker); comfortable operating services on ECS or K8s
  • Strong Linux networking (DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls, VPN/hybrid)
  • Proven experience planning and executing migration to on-prem, colo, or private cloud (partial/hybrid OK — full exit not required)
  • Comfortable owning a multi-quarter infra initiative: TCO, design, vendors, cutover, rollback
  • Comfortable automating operational tasks with shell and/or Python
  • Fluent English (both spoken and written)

Strongly preferred

  • Colo/bare-metal ops: IPAM (NetBox), Ansible, image-based provisioning (Packer or equivalent), HAProxy/Nginx
  • Replacing managed AWS services with self-hosted (Postgres HA, Redis/Valkey, Kafka, OpenSearch)
  • Email infrastructure (MTA, SMTP, IP reputation, DKIM/SPF/DMARC) — Halon or similar
  • Cloudflare (DNS/WAF/Access)
  • Observability beyond CloudWatch (Prometheus/Grafana/Loki or equivalent)
  • Prior work with multi-region SaaS or EU data residency
  • Cost-driven architecture / FinOps mindset

Would be a plus

  • GCP (BigQuery/certificates)
  • Comfortable reading Ruby or Go (used in our services and tooling)
  • AWS Certificates

Responsibilities day-to-day

  • Operate and evolve AWS multi-account / multi-region infra
  • Terraform modules/workspaces
  • Ensure safe infrastructure changes across network, storage, and services, with zero-downtime deployments.
  • ECS services, blue/green deploys, Docker image pipelines
  • Reliability: CloudWatch/PagerDuty/Sentry, capacity, cost tags
  • Security baseline: IAM, secrets (SSM), Cloudflare edge rules
  • Partner with engineers on release automation and production readiness
  • Maintain the hybrid estate (AWS and rented bare metal) as one operable platform

Migration leadership

  • Build the business and technical case for what moves off AWS vs what stays
  • Design the rented bare-metal / colo landing zone (compute, network, storage, observability, secrets)
  • Produce migration waves, dependency maps, cutover/rollback plans
  • Stand up hybrid connectivity and dual-run periods; shift traffic safely (e.g. via Cloudflare)
  • Replace or re-home managed services where it pays off (compute, queues, search, cache, MTA nodes)
  • Coordinate colo/vendors, timelines, and eng teams; report progress and risk

raw.description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

In this role you will lead a team of our world class Technical Account Managers (TAMs), representing and supporting our SMB merchants. As the manager, you will oversee a talented team of TAMs who are responsible for the technical success of our SMB merchants post-sale. You will support and guide your team towards best practice solutions as they advise merchant developers, product teams, and key business partners throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial product integration through expansion and scale. This team is tasked with not only guiding their merchants to avoid pitfalls, but to take advantage of more of Affirm’s offerings; solving business objectives with technical strategies and product optimizations. Technical Account Managers are a part of the Engineering Team and work closely with Affirm’s Client Success, Product Management, Operations, and Merchant Care teams.

What you'll do

  • Coach, mentor and develop an awesome group of experienced TAMs who support our SMB merchants.
  • Work closely with our Client Success counterparts to help our network of merchants grow, by not only enabling an efficient time to market, but also by taking better advantage of Affirm’s expanding product suite post launch
  • Establish and track team OKRs and goals, establishing proactive action plans for meeting goals when needed
  • Forecast the demand for TAMs and recruit as necessary
  • Technically, you will evaluate new hires on their technical capabilities, handle escalations from your own team, provide guidance to the TAMs on integration solutions, troubleshooting and optimization opportunities, and be seen as an expert by our customers
  • Be a strong internal advocate for our merchants, working cross functionally to make sure their highest priorities are being met

What we look for

  • At least five years in a b2b customer facing technical role and three years as a people manager.
  • A strong technical background in web development technologies and REST APIs, with a computer science degree or professional engineering experience.
  • A great relationship builder who has the ability to quickly build rapport with engineering customers.
  • A fantastic communicator, both when advocating for customers internally and advocating for Affirm externally.
  • Bonus: Experience providing solutions to e-commerce or in-store retailers.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
  • ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.

Overview

BRMi is seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer to support a large financial services client.

The successful candidate will be working with IT, industrial internet of things (IoT) and operational technology teams to lead technology driven business process transformation and innovation for Navy Federal Credit Union. They will partner with IT, Risk, Security and Audit teams to establish operational compliance that streamlines operations while protecting the organization.

The ideal candidate will serve as a subject matter expert for Physical Security Surveillance systems using Avigilon Unity Cloud Solution having strong cyber/device security and network engineering skills. This candidate will work closely with the team to understand connected devices/internet of things in depth and to document the product details including the security architecture, trust boundaries and data flows. They will provide product security related coaching/mentoring and security expertise for all IoT device teams.

Benefits:• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance• Employer-Paid Life Insurance• Employer-Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance• 401(k) • Paid Time Off (PTO) that includes Vacation Leave, Sick Leave, and 11 Paid Holidays• Educational Assistance

Salary: $136K-146K

**Can be 100% remote in TX, VA, MD, DC, or FL**

**High Profile roles may require candidates to fly to customer HQ for in person interview prior to offer to prevent employment fraud (expenses paid)**

Click here to learn about BRMi's culture.

Click here to see BRMi’s Glassdoor reviews

Responsibilities

  • Professional understanding of the essential requirements of IoT architecture, scalability, real-time capability, data protection and security
  • Identify security risk in Navy Federal’s IoT device ecosystem and communicate those risks to management and assist with the mitigation efforts
  • Oversee and manage the deployment, integration and configuration of security solutions and any enhancements to existing IoT security solutions and the enterprise's security documents
  • Perform security research, analysis, and testing via threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and/or social engineering across a wide variety of applications, platforms and systems
  • Work with Industry solution providers, equipment manufacturers, and the Enterprise Resource Planning vendor to design and implement the required systems integrations points and data flow to achieve best in class lights-out-operations
  • Partner with sensors specialists to manage new sensors data streaming to IoT platform, and with data scientists and machine learning engineers to take on analytic results and develop it to an application with user interface, integrate with any pre-existing systems, demonstrate successful use cases and wins, etc.
  • Understand systems flow, data source, data usage and technical requirements clearly, to meet the functionalities per user requirements
  • Accountable for the improvement and delivery of the applications geared towards the industrial communications and data collection

Qualifications

  • Experience with Surveillance Systems, Cyber Security and Network Security
  • Experience with configuring and designing segmented networking
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, HTTP, UDP, and XML
  • Knowledge of IoT software platforms such as ORDR, ARMIS, Azure IoT or Cisco IoT Hub
  • Proven ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment
  • Familiarity with OT environment security with risk-based management, vulnerabilities, asset and threat protection, security behavioral analytics, and security environmental configurationNote: All the considerations above should be addressed in platforms to include Cloud, On-Prem, Hybrid, with various operating systems
  • Minimum 7 years of Information Security and Physical Security Experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of Industrial Internet of things experience including rapid design, prototyping and deployment of embedded systems
  • Experience with communicating and data collection from systems such as sensors, controllers, and industrial systems
  • Able to articulate and present IoT concepts to senior management
  • Experience in Industrial environment is an asset
  • Experience with PLC, DCS and SCADA is an asset
  • Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment
  • Ability to align and influence critical stakeholders
  • Strong supporter of customer centricity. Understands the importance of demonstrating concern for satisfying customers. Passionate about developing goals to improve customer experience
  • Retain and convey a positive attitude in challenging circumstances
