raw.title: Senior Graphic Designer
raw.excerpt: Position OverviewWe are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who can turn strategy into visual impact.
raw.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer who can turn strategy into visual impact.

At Childcare Marketing Group, we help childcare centers and early education businesses attract more families, strengthen their brands, and grow. Our creative work is not decoration — it is a critical part of how our clients communicate, compete, and generate results.

As our Senior Graphic Designer, you will take ownership of visual execution across a diverse portfolio of clients. You will work from concept through completion, translating marketing strategies and campaign objectives into creative that is compelling, commercially-minded, and built to perform.

This is not a role for someone who simply waits for a brief and follows instructions.

We want a designer who can think, challenge, create, refine, and raise the creative standard. Someone who understands that great design combines creativity with strategy, knows how to work at speed without sacrificing quality, and has the confidence to own projects from beginning to end.

You will work across multiple projects, brands, and formats while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and consistently delivering work that clients are proud to put their name behind.

Compensation

  • Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and level of expertise.
  • Performance Bonuses: Additional earning potential may be available based on performance and company programs.

Why You Should Work Here

● Work That Matters: You help transform lives by supporting the marketing of businesses that care for and educate children. Your creative work helps childcare providers connect with more families who need their services.

● Recession-Proof Growth: Childcare is an essential industry, and our clients need effective marketing to continue attracting families, filling places, and growing their businesses.

● Leadership That Has Your Back: You’ll work with a supportive, attentive, and motivated leadership team that wants you to succeed and gives you the support to keep developing.

● An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business and invested in building a high-performing company and team.

● Small-Team Feel: You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas are visible, your work matters, and you’re treated as a person rather than a headcount.

● Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection while staying closely connected to a collaborative international team.

● Top-of-Market Opportunity: We want exceptional people and believe strong talent should have the opportunity to grow with the company.

● Train to Be the Best: Extensive initial and ongoing training, courses, and professional development designed to help you become exceptionally strong at what you do.

● A Workspace That Feels Alive: Our remote environment is designed to keep the team connected, collaborative, and engaged even when we're working from different parts of the world.

● Quarterly Town Halls: Regular company-wide updates so you understand what is happening across the business and where we are heading.

● The Dream-On Program: Our CEO grants multiple wishes each year pulled directly from team members' dream boards.

● 25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because great work requires time to recharge and have a life outside work.

● Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days each year to volunteer with a charity of your choice.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will understand our creative standards, clients, workflows, and brand requirements and begin taking full ownership of your design projects.

Ongoing, you will be measured on:

● Creative Quality: Consistently producing polished, original, high-quality creative that meets or exceeds professional agency standards.

● Creative Ownership: Taking projects from initial concept through final delivery with minimal supervision and strong judgment at every stage.

● Brand Consistency: Ensuring every asset reflects the client's brand, audience, positioning, and campaign objectives.

● Strategic Design: Creating visuals that do more than look good — they communicate clearly, support marketing objectives, and contribute to measurable campaign outcomes.

● Speed & Reliability: Managing multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing quality or allowing important details to slip through the cracks.

● Attention to Detail: Catching inconsistencies, errors, spacing issues, formatting problems, and other details before work reaches the client.

● Collaboration: Working effectively with marketers, strategists, copywriters, account managers, and other creative team members to produce stronger work.

● Client Impact: Creating work that clients value, approve confidently, and can use effectively across their marketing.

A Typical Week Might Include

● Reviewing creative briefs and marketing objectives before translating them into visual concepts.

● Developing concepts, layouts, graphics, advertisements, social media creative, presentations, and other marketing assets.

● Taking a project from rough concept through design, revision, approval, and final delivery.

● Collaborating with Account Managers, Marketing Strategists, copywriters, and other internal specialists.

● Reviewing existing client creative and identifying opportunities to improve visual consistency and effectiveness.

● Managing multiple projects simultaneously while prioritizing deadlines and maintaining quality.

● Presenting creative concepts and explaining the strategic thinking behind your design decisions.

● Responding to feedback, refining creative, and knowing when to push an idea further versus when to move forward.

● Staying current with design trends, creative technology, AI tools, and evolving visual communication practices.

Key Competencies

● Creative Thinker: You generate original ideas rather than simply replicating what already exists.

● Exceptional Attention to Detail: You notice the small things that separate good design from outstanding design.

● Strategic Designer: You understand that design needs to serve an audience, communicate a message, and support a business objective.

● High Standards: You hold your own work to a professional standard and are not satisfied with "good enough."

● Excellent Communicator: You can explain creative decisions clearly and confidently to both internal teammates and professional clients.

● Problem Solver: You can work through unclear briefs, creative challenges, competing priorities, and tight deadlines without becoming stuck.

● Adaptable: You can move between different brands, industries, audiences, and creative requirements without losing quality.

● Time Management Master: You know how to manage your workload, prioritize competing deadlines, and deliver consistently.

● Collaborative: You know when to lead creatively, when to listen, and how to make the people around you better.

● Resilient & Self-Confident: You are comfortable receiving feedback, defending a strong creative idea when appropriate, and continually improving your work.

This Role Is Not for You If

● You need someone to give you exact instructions for every design decision.

● You are primarily interested in making things look attractive without considering the marketing objective behind them.

● You struggle to manage multiple projects or deadlines simultaneously.

● You take creative feedback personally or resist revisions.

● You regularly miss small details that affect the quality of finished work.

● You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving agency environment where priorities can change.

● You need constant supervision to stay productive.

● You are not interested in continuing to develop your creative skills and staying current with new design tools and trends.

Skills and Experience Required

● 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong track record of producing commercial, marketing-focused creative in an agency, in-house marketing, advertising, or similarly fast-paced environment.

● A strong portfolio demonstrating high-level commercial and marketing design work across multiple formats and industries.

● Thorough understanding of graphic design principles, including typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, colour, visual storytelling, and brand consistency.

● Demonstrated ability to take a project from concept through final execution.

● Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

● Strong understanding of designing for digital marketing, including social media, paid advertising, web, email, and other digital channels.

● Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

● Strong attention to detail and quality control.

● A reliable remote work setup and ability to work independently.

Preferred Skills and Experience

● Previous experience working in a digital marketing or creative agency.

● Experience designing creative specifically for paid advertising and conversion-focused campaigns.

● Experience working across multiple client brands simultaneously.

● Experience with motion graphics, video editing, animation, or other multimedia design.

● Experience with Figma, Canva, or similar collaborative design platforms.

● Familiarity with AI-assisted creative and design tools.

● Experience designing for childcare, education, franchise, healthcare, or other multi-location businesses.

● Experience presenting creative concepts to clients or senior stakeholders.

● Understanding of marketing performance and how creativity can influence engagement, conversion, and acquisition.

Work Environment

This is a full-time, remote-first position.

About Childcare Marketing Group

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow with smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Full-Stack Web App Developers (JavaScript/TypeScript + Python or Node) to join the Tendem project () and build interactive browser-based applications for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your full-stack engineering expertise to design, build, and maintain functional, robust, and user-friendly web applications. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in modern frontend frameworks, backend APIs, databases, and shipping interactive web products end-to-end.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Full-Stack Web App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine browser-based applications with real logic, state, persistence, and user input — from habit trackers and budgeting tools to internal dashboards, mini-SaaS tools, and AI-powered apps. You may also work on standalone Python applications and data-processing scripts that sit alongside or behind these products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build interactive web applications with frontend (React, Next.js, Vue, or similar) and a backend API (Python/FastAPI/Flask or Node/Express).
  • Design and implement data models, schemas, and persistence layers using SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite) or NoSQL stores.
  • Implement authentication, sessions, and basic role-based access where needed.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and AI/LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into product features.
  • Handle state management, user input validation, error states, and loading states cleanly.
  • Build standalone Python tools and scripts where required by the task (data processing, API clients, lightweight backend utilities).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor full-stack applications to improve correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Write clear, testable code and debug end-to-end issues across frontend, backend, and database.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in full-stack web development or shipping interactive web applications (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in full-stack web development, modern frontend frameworks, backend architecture, and building interactive browser-based applications end-to-end. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs, design robust application logic, and build production-ready web applications. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently architect and ship complete features are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar).
  • Solid backend experience in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/or Node.js (Express, NestJS).
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and basic schema design.
  • Experience implementing REST APIs, request validation, error handling, and authentication flows.
  • Familiarity with deployment platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Render, , Railway, or similar).
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or other AI services into product features is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable with version control (Git) and basic testing practices.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to building working, robust products — not demos.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to architect, build, and ship features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped web applications (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

BeOne is a global oncology company that is discovering and developing innovative treatments that are more affordable and accessible to cancer patients worldwide. We are committed to radically improving access to medicines for far more patients who need them. BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

Job Description:

General Description:

The Associate Director/Director, Commercial Excellence & Insights, JAPAC, is a regional functional leadership role responsible for driving commercial insights, analytics and sales force effectiveness (SFE) capabilities across the JAPAC region.

The role serves as the regional functional engine for:

  • integrated business insights,

  • market research,

  • competitive intelligence,

  • commercial analytics,

  • performance reporting,

  • KPI governance, and

  • sales force effectiveness.

The primary objective of the role is to enable data-driven decision-making and improve commercial execution effectiveness through scalable regional frameworks, actionable insights and commercial performance optimization.

The role partners closely with regional and local commercial leadership, sales operations, marketing, medical, market access, finance and global commercial excellence teams to support strategic decision-making, improve field force effectiveness and drive consistent commercial excellence practices across JAPAC markets.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Commercial Insights & Analytics

Lead the development and execution of integrated regional Commercial Insights & Analytics capabilities across JAPAC, serving as the regional functional engine for business insights, analytics and commercial performance optimization. The role is responsible for enabling data-driven decision-making through the synthesis of market intelligence, commercial analytics and strategic performance insights.

Key areas of responsibility include:

  • Market research

  • Competitive intelligence

  • Commercial analytics and performance reporting

  • Forecasting support, including regional scenario planning and strategic simulations related to market events, launches, competitive dynamics and portfolio decisions

  • KPI measurement and analytics frameworks

The role translates regional and local business questions into actionable insights that support:

  • Commercial strategy

  • Launch readiness

  • Portfolio optimization

  • Resource prioritization

  • Commercial execution improvement

Working closely with local markets, the role consolidates market intelligence, identifies commercial opportunities and risks, generates actionable recommendations and improves business decision-making across the region.

The role also owns the operational delivery and synthesis of:

  • Regional market research initiatives

  • Competitive intelligence programs

  • Commercial performance dashboards

  • Executive business insights reporting

In addition, the role drives consistency and best practices across markets for:

  • Insight generation methodologies

  • KPI definitions

  • Reporting standards

  • Analytics frameworks

  • Commercial data utilization

The role supports recurring business reviews and performance discussions through insight generation and analytical support.

Sales Force Effectiveness

Lead the development and implementation of scalable regional Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE) frameworks and analytics capabilities to improve field force productivity, customer engagement and commercial execution effectiveness across JAPAC.

Key areas of responsibility include:

  • Segmentation and targeting frameworks

  • Territory alignment and field force sizing support

  • Call planning analytics

  • Customer engagement metrics

  • Omnichannel effectiveness measurement

  • Sales force KPI frameworks

Partner with country commercial and sales operations teams to optimize:

  • Field force deployment

  • Customer coverage

  • Sales execution effectiveness

  • CRM utilization

  • Commercial productivity

Provide regional analytics and recommendations to support continuous improvement in customer engagement and field force effectiveness.

Benchmark field force performance across markets and identify scalable best practices.

Support implementation and adoption of commercial excellence tools, dashboards and reporting capabilities.

3. Incentives Governance Support (Secondary Support Role)

Provide analytical support and governance input to regional and local stakeholders to help inform sales incentive governance frameworks across JAPAC.

Responsibilities include:

  • Commercial analytics and performance insights

  • Benchmarking and KPI recommendations

  • Incentive effectiveness observations

  • Support for alignment between incentives, strategic priorities and desired commercial behaviors

4. Commercial Training Enablement (Enablement Role)

Support regional commercial capability development by translating insights and SFE priorities into commercial excellence enablement initiatives and best practices across the region.

Areas of contribution include:

  • Commercial excellence playbooks

  • KPI education and reporting standards

  • CRM adoption support

  • SFE methodology enablement

  • Sales effectiveness frameworks

  • Cross-market best practice sharing

The role partners with local markets and training stakeholders to support adoption of global and regional commercial excellence standards, tools and frameworks.

Qualification Required:

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in:

  • Business,

  • Life Sciences,

  • Pharmacy,

  • Economics,

  • Marketing,

  • Engineering,

  • Data Analytics,

    or a related discipline required

  • MBA or advanced degree preferred

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None to start

Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams.

  • Strong working knowledge of commercial analytics, dashboarding, and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar platforms.

  • Familiarity with CRM and sales force effectiveness platforms, including Veeva CRM, Salesforce, IQVIA solutions or equivalent systems.

  • Experience using commercial data, pharmaceutical market data, sales performance data and customer engagement data to generate actionable insights.

  • Ability to interpret complex datasets, guide analytical approaches and translate outputs into clear business recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  • Understanding of CRM governance, data quality, dashboard standards and KPI reporting frameworks preferred.

  • Experience with forecasting, scenario planning, performance reporting, or commercial planning tools preferred.

Other Qualifications:

  • Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to translate insights into practical commercial recommendations.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in complex, matrixed and multicultural regional organizations.

  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information for senior stakeholders.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across commercial, sales operations, marketing, medical, finance, market access and global teams.

  • Proven ability to balance regional standardization with local market flexibility.

  • Strong project management, prioritization and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple markets and workstreams.

  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to lead through influence without direct authority.

  • Strong analytical mindset with sound judgment, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguity.

  • Experience supporting oncology, specialty care or innovative medicines businesses preferred.

Travel:

  • Approximately 10–20% across JAPAC markets and global meetings, as business needs require.

What We Offer To Our Valued Employees

  • Market competitive compensation package including performance-based annual bonus scheme

  • Company shares (generous welcome grant!)

  • In-house and external learning and development opportunities

  • Fantastic benefits program and keep improving!

  • Plus you get to work with a dynamic team of collaborative, supportive, inclusive, and fun professionals whose mission is clear: Cancer has no borders and neither do we.

  • Join us and Make momentum in your career!

BeOne Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Collaborative Spirit, Bold Ingenuity and Driving Excellence, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

BeOne is committed to respect and protect personal information rights of job applicants and will process job applicants’ personal information in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Due to BeOne’s global operation, job applicants’ data will be stored overseas with adequate protection. Besides, job applicants’ data will be stored for no longer than is necessary to facilitate potential application for other suitable positions in BeOne. For further details, please refer to BeOne’s Job Applicant Privacy Policy ().

As the leading foodservice and support services company, Compass Group USA is known for our great people, great service and our great results. We have over 284,000 US associates who work in award-winning restaurants, corporate cafes, hospitals, schools, arenas, museums, and more in all 50 states. great people. great services. great results.

Each and every individual plays a key role in the growth and legacy of our company. We know the next big idea can come from anyone. We encourage developing and attracting expertise that differentiates us as a company as we continue to raise the bar.

Job Summary:

The Retention Partnerships & Best Practices Sr. Director is responsible for driving the adoption, consistency, scalability, and continuous improvement of Compass Group's retention strategies, tools, and methodologies across sectors. This role serves as the liaison between the core retention strategy, Strategic Alliance sector retention teams, operators, and enterprise resources to ensure retention programs are implemented effectively and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Will build strong partnerships across sectors, identify and scale successful retention practices, and help establish a consistent retention operating model that improves account health management, increases contract extensions, and protects revenue. This role acts as the bridge between retention strategy and field execution, ensuring that insights, tools, resources, and best practices are translated into action across the organization.

Responsibilities:

Sector Partnerships & Relationship Management

  • Serve as a strategic partner to sector retention teams and operational stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships that foster collaboration, alignment, and shared accountability for retention outcomes.
  • Understand sector-specific retention challenges, opportunities, and priorities.
  • Gather and communicate sector feedback to support the evolution of retention strategies, tools, and programs.

Retention Excellence, Consistency & Scalability

  • Drive consistency and scalability of retention processes, tools, playbooks, and best practices across sectors while respecting sector-specific business needs.
  • Support the implementation and adoption of enterprise retention methodologies, including Account Health Scores and Retention Risk Factors.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and scale successful retention approaches across the organization.
  • Promote alignment around retention priorities, processes, and performance measures.

Best Practices & Knowledge Management

  • Identify, document, and disseminate successful retention strategies, interventions, and client engagement practices.
  • Maintain and evolve a centralized repository of retention resources, templates, playbooks, and tools.
  • Facilitate cross-sector collaboration and sharing of lessons learned.
  • Lead communities of practice, retention forums, and best-practice discussions to encourage continuous learning and innovation.
  • Partner with the Retention Training & Development team to ensure best practices are incorporated into training and learning programs.

Adoption & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor adoption and utilization of retention tools, methodologies, and resources.
  • Facilitate portfolio reviews and discussions focused on retention risks and opportunities.
  • Partner with sector teams to identify barriers to adoption and develop improvement plans.
  • Recommend enhancements to retention programs, processes, and resources based on stakeholder feedback, performance trends, and business outcomes.
  • Support change management efforts related to retention initiatives and new capabilities.

Program Support & Governance

  • Support retention governance processes and enterprise retention initiatives.
  • Track and communicate progress against retention objectives and adoption goals.
  • Collaborate with VP of Analytics & Transformation and Retention Training & Development teams to ensure alignment between insights, resources, training, and execution.
  • Contribute to strategic planning and roadmap development for the Core Retention organization.
  • Support the measurement and communication of retention program impact and business value.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in account retention, client relationship management, operations, business transformation, customer success, strategic program management, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining partnerships across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide initiatives that drive adoption, process improvement, or organizational change.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Experience developing and implementing best practices, operational frameworks, or scalable business processes.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and complex projects in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data and insights into action.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Hospitality, Organizational Development, Communications, or a related field.
  • Experience within Compass Group or a multi-unit, service-oriented, hospitality, foodservice, healthcare, education, or facilities management environment.
  • Experience supporting client retention, contract renewals, customer success, or account management functions.
  • Knowledge of account health scoring, retention strategies, risk management frameworks, or customer lifecycle management.
  • Experience with change management, training adoption, or organizational effectiveness initiatives.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, business intelligence tools, reporting platforms, and learning management systems.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or related field) preferred.

Core Competencies:

  • Relationship Building & Influence
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Collaboration & Partnership
  • Change Leadership
  • Knowledge Sharing & Continuous Improvement
  • Program & Project Management
  • Communication & Facilitation
  • Analytical & Business Acumen

Data Science & Analysis, Data Science Consulting

Travel Required:

None

Guidehouse is seeking a Databricks Data Scientist to join our AI & Data team to support client projects involving advanced analytics, machine learning, and data science solutions. This role focuses on working with data to develop models, generate insights, and support data-driven decision-making across teams. The role requires strong Python and SQL skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate with clients and stakeholders to deliver scalable data science solutions.

This position offers virtual work flexibility within the United States. While remote candidates will be considered, preference will be given to candidates located near a Guidehouse office in one of the following markets: Arlington, VA; Washington, DC; New York, NY; Chicago, IL; Austin, TX; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; and Boulder, CO.

Please note, this requisition supports hiring across multiple levels to support our Databricks Data Science Teams. The posted salary range represents a range of potential compensation and will vary based on the selected candidate’s experience, qualifications, location, and the level at which the position is filled.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning and statistical models to support business and mission needs using the Databricks platform.

  • Prepare, clean, and maintain datasets for modeling, experimentation, and analysis.

  • Write, optimize, and maintain Python and SQL workflows for data exploration, feature engineering, and model development.

  • Work with large-scale datasets using Databricks, Spark, and Delta Lake platforms.

  • Design reusable feature engineering workflows and model training pipelines using Databricks notebooks, workflows, and MLflow.

  • Register, version, promote, and document models using MLflow Model Registry and Unity Catalog-based model governance practices.

  • Monitor deployed models for performance, drift, data quality, usage patterns, and operational issues; recommend retraining, tuning, or retirement actions as needed.

  • Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and insights to support business decisions.

  • Translate business requirements into analytical approaches, models, and data science solutions.

  • Perform data validation, quality checks, and issue resolution to ensure accuracy and consistency.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.

  • Communicate model outputs, analytical findings, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Document models, datasets, and methodologies to support reproducibility, transparency, and reuse.

  • Follow data governance, security, and compliance standards within the platform.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or another relevant field.

  • 3-8 years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, or advanced analytics.

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL for data analysis, modeling, and transformation.

  • Experience with Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, or similar cloud-native data platforms.

  • Hands-on experience designing, building, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models, including experience moving models from prototype to production or production-like environments.

  • Experience with ML lifecycle practices including experiment tracking, model evaluation, model registry, version control, deployment workflows, monitoring, and retraining approaches.

  • Familiarity with model serving patterns, API-based inference, scheduled batch scoring, and integration of model outputs into dashboards, applications, or operational workflows.

  • Experience with data preparation, feature engineering, and model development.

  • Ability to analyze data and communicate insights clearly.

  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, communicate recommendations clearly, and work effectively in team-based delivery environments.

  • Experience supporting AI governance practices, including model documentation, validation, monitoring, version control, and responsible AI considerations.

  • Ability to work across data science, data engineering, cloud, security, and client stakeholder teams to translate analytical prototypes into scalable, maintainable solutions.

What Would Be Nice to Have:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with the Databricks platform.

  • Active Databricks Machine Learning Engineer, GenAI Engineer, Data Analyst, or related certification.

  • Experience with Databricks MLflow, Feature Engineering, Feature Store, Model Serving, Workflows, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI, Vector Search, AI Gateway, or related Databricks AI/ML capabilities.

  • Experience developing GenAI, LLM, RAG, agentic AI, or prompt evaluation workflows using Databricks Mosaic AI, MLflow, open-source frameworks, or cloud-native AI services.

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, code packaging, environment promotion, and source control practices for data science and machine learning workloads.

  • Experience with machine learning frameworks and statistical modeling techniques.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

  • Experience working in project-based or consulting delivery environments.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, data warehousing, and large-scale data processing concepts.

The annual salary range for this position is $113,000.00-$188,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

raw.description:
About Homeaglow

Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes. We delight customers and empower cleaning professionals by building the leading platform for home services. Today, we are the world’s largest marketplace for home cleanings. Tomorrow, we’ll be the world’s leading platform for all home services.

We are transforming the home services industry by making high-quality home cleanings more accessible, affordable, and transparent for everyone. We connect customers with independent, background-checked cleaning professionals through a modern technology platform that simplifies booking, pricing, and communication.

Why Join Homeaglow?

A True Startup Environment

Join a high-growth, entrepreneurial company where speed, ownership, and impact define the culture.

Sustained, Profitable Growth

Double-digit year-over-year growth at a nine-figure revenue scale, while serving less than 0.5% of U.S. households — with significant runway ahead.

Strong Unit Economics

Disciplined focus on LTV/CAC and long-term value creation drives sustainable expansion.

Bootstrapped & Focused

No liquidation preferences. No distracting investor pressure. Just stable priorities and long-term thinking.

Real Economic Impact

Over 100,000 cleaning professionals have earned $250M+ through our platform. Average earnings are ~50% higher than traditional hotel housekeeping roles.

Vertical Expansion Strategy

Significant opportunity to expand into adjacent services and deepen customer relationships.

Building a World-Class Team

Be part of a professional, high-caliber team scaling a category-defining platform.

About the Team

The Strategy & Analytics team focuses on systematically improving our customer and service provider experience and increasing the efficiency of our Operations organization, which comprises 500+ contractors across Growth and Customer Care teams. We are the source of truth on analytics and analytical tools.

This team is a vehicle to bring in top analytics talent to our business. This role will have high visibility and work with stakeholders in operations, product, and finance. Potential career paths are rising within Strategy & Analytics or moving into a GM-style role owning a P&L in Growth or Care.

We are looking for a Strategy Manager to join our Strategy & Analytics team to drive new projects in the Operations organization with a rigorous analytics lens.

What you will do:

  • Design and implement experiments to stand up new Operations motions that drive company value, working end-to-end from building playbooks and training agent teams to reporting on statistical significance and ROI. These projects might look like testing the impact of rolling out a new live chat feature or starting a team to contact idle customers or cleaners to re-engage them.
  • In partnership with data analysts, build out KPI reporting for new and existing Operations motions using SQL, Tableau, and Google Sheets/Excel and own weekly reporting to COO and other Homeaglow management.

Requirements

  • 1-3 years of experience in a technology or consulting company, and a top-tier university degree in a quantitative field (engineering, business/economics, mathematics, etc).
  • You’re an expert at pulling data in SQL and are comfortable in Excel/Google Sheets. Familiarity with visualization tools like Metabase, Power BI, Looker, Tableau is helpful, but not required as long as you’re willing to learn.
  • You have a natural curiosity to leverage data to solve problems and identify opportunities.
  • You’re unafraid of ambiguity. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environments.
  • Familiarity with basic statistics and experimental setup.
  • Excellent problem solving and communication skills, and experience driving projects independently.

Perks and Benefits

  • Health insurance fully covered by the company.
  • Parental leave .
  • Flexible / unlimited PTO policy.
  • Cleaning membership perk – Free Homeaglow membership with complimentary cleanings. Enjoy up to 2x cleanings a month, capped at $200 USD per cleaning.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Homeaglow is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Accommodations

We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our hiring process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.

Pay Transparency

Compensation ranges are available upon request. Final offers are based on experience, skills, and location in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws.

raw.description:
Senior Accountant – GAAP/IFRS, Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, aligned with U.S. client business hours

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to own critical accounting processes, maintain financial accuracy, support compliance, and provide reliable financial reporting and insights to leadership.

This is not a transactional bookkeeping role.

You’ll take ownership of core accounting functions including:

  • General ledger accounting
  • Month-end and quarter-end close
  • Balance sheet reconciliations
  • Financial reporting and variance analysis
  • Audit and tax support
  • Internal controls
  • Accounting process improvement
  • Junior team mentorship

The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge of GAAP/IFRS with hands-on accounting execution, analytical thinking, and a process-improvement mindset.

What You’ll Own

General Ledger & Account Reconciliations

  • Prepare and post journal entries for:
    • Accruals
    • Prepaid expenses
    • Payroll allocations
    • Depreciation
    • Intercompany transactions
  • Maintain reconciliations across approximately 15–30 key balance sheet accounts.
  • Reconcile cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, deferred revenue, and other accounts.
  • Investigate discrepancies and ensure issues are resolved accurately.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready accounting records.

Month-End & Quarter-End Close

Own and coordinate monthly and quarterly close activities.

You will:

  • Prepare and review trial balances.
  • Ensure journal entries are complete and accurate.
  • Complete month-end close within approximately 5–7 business days, with a target of five days.
  • Maintain detailed close checklists.
  • Coordinate required cross-functional sign-offs.
  • Identify and resolve issues that could delay reporting.
  • Continuously improve close efficiency and accuracy.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and review:
    • Profit & Loss statements
    • Balance sheets
    • Cash flow statements
    • Supporting schedules
  • Perform budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual variance analysis.
  • Investigate significant financial variances.
  • Prepare written commentary explaining financial performance.
  • Provide actionable financial insights for leadership.
  • Prepare supporting schedules for board meetings, audits, and other reporting requirements.

Audit, Tax & Compliance Support

  • Prepare PBC (Prepared by Client) schedules and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Respond to audit requests accurately and within required timelines.
  • Support timely and accurate filings for:
    • Sales tax
    • Property tax
    • Corporate income tax
  • Maintain accounting policies, controls, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure accounting processes align with applicable GAAP and/or IFRS standards.
  • Identify accounting or control risks and escalate issues appropriately.

Internal Controls & Accounting Accuracy

  • Maintain strong controls across accounting workflows.
  • Review reconciliations and supporting documentation for completeness.
  • Identify unusual transactions, exceptions, and accounting discrepancies.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation and approval processes are followed.
  • Help maintain accurate, consistent, and audit-ready financial records.

Process Improvement & Automation

Identify opportunities to make accounting operations faster, more accurate, and more scalable.

You will:

  • Review existing accounting workflows and identify inefficiencies.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements.
  • Identify opportunities for accounting and reporting automation.
  • Update SOPs and accounting documentation.
  • Standardize recurring accounting processes.
  • Support ERP improvements and finance system optimization initiatives.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Review work completed by staff accountants and bookkeepers.
  • Provide feedback on reconciliations, journal entries, and financial reporting.
  • Mentor junior team members on accounting treatments and best practices.
  • Help improve accuracy and consistency across the accounting function.
  • Support the professional development of junior accounting staff.

Cross-Functional Finance Collaboration

Partner with:

  • FP&A
  • Operations
  • Sales
  • Finance leadership
  • Other business stakeholders

You will:

  • Support budgeting and forecasting processes.
  • Collaborate on variance reviews.
  • Coordinate with operations and sales regarding revenue recognition.
  • Provide financial information needed for business decisions.
  • Translate accounting data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders.

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4–5+ years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Strong understanding of GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • General ledger accounting
    • Journal entries
    • Balance sheet reconciliations
    • Month-end close
    • Financial statement preparation
    • Variance analysis
    • Audit support
  • Experience with accounting systems such as:
    • NetSuite
    • QuickBooks
    • Xero
    • SAP
    • Similar ERP/accounting platforms
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Pivot Tables
    • VLOOKUP
    • INDEX/MATCH
    • Conditional formatting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting certification.
  • NetSuite experience.
  • Multi-entity accounting and consolidations.
  • Foreign currency accounting.
  • Experience in:
    • SaaS
    • Professional services
    • Real estate
  • Experience supporting ERP implementations.
  • Accounting automation or finance transformation experience.
  • Experience working directly with FP&A teams.
  • Experience mentoring junior accountants or bookkeepers.
  • Familiarity with Confluence or similar documentation systems.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Understand accounting principles beyond basic bookkeeping.
  • Take ownership of financial accuracy and reporting deadlines.
  • Can independently manage month-end close responsibilities.
  • Are highly analytical without losing attention to detail.
  • Investigate discrepancies rather than simply recording adjustments.
  • Maintain organized and audit-ready documentation.
  • Can explain financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Look for ways to improve and automate repetitive accounting processes.
  • Are comfortable reviewing and mentoring junior team members.
  • Thrive in structured, deadline-driven environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Morning

  • Review bank activity and reconcile recent transactions.
  • Post accruals for payroll, vendor invoices, and other expenses.
  • Review exception reports and investigate unusual activity.
  • Check progress against the accounting close calendar.

Midday

  • Prepare or review draft financial statements.
  • Analyze expense allocations against budgets and forecasts.
  • Investigate material variances.
  • Meet with Operations or other stakeholders regarding deferred revenue or reporting questions.

Afternoon

  • Review balance sheet reconciliations prepared by junior team members.
  • Provide feedback on accounting treatments and documentation.
  • Resolve outstanding close items.
  • Support audit, tax, or compliance requests.

End of Day

  • Update variance analysis and financial commentary.
  • Review month-end close progress.
  • Update accounting schedules, SOPs, and supporting documentation.
  • Prepare outstanding items for the following day.

In short: you ensure financial operations remain accurate, compliant, efficient, audit-ready, and useful for decision-making.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Month-end close completed within 5 business days.
  • Less than 1% reconciliation error rate.
  • 100% of audit requests delivered on time.
  • Accurate and timely financial statements.
  • Strong quality and consistency of variance analysis.
  • Complete and audit-ready accounting documentation.
  • Improved close and reporting efficiency.
  • Effective mentorship and review of junior accounting staff.
  • Leadership confidence in financial reporting accuracy.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership across core accounting operations.
  • Exposure to both accounting execution and financial analysis.
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and FP&A.
  • Opportunity to improve accounting systems and processes.
  • Exposure to ERP and finance automation initiatives.
  • Fully remote environment with flexibility around U.S. client operations.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Accounting Manager
    • Senior Accounting Manager
    • Controller
    • Finance Operations Manager
    • Director of Accounting

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your overall accounting experience and the types of companies you’ve supported.
  • Your experience managing month-end and quarter-end close.
  • The number and types of balance sheet accounts you have personally reconciled.
  • Your experience working under GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Which accounting or ERP platforms you have used, particularly NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or SAP.
  • An example of a reconciliation discrepancy or accounting issue you identified and resolved.
  • Your experience preparing financial statements and variance analysis.
  • Your experience supporting external audits and preparing PBC schedules.
  • An accounting process you improved or automated.
  • Your experience reviewing or mentoring the work of junior accountants or bookkeepers.

Keep your answers clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand the depth of your accounting experience, technical knowledge, communication skills, and ability to take ownership of financial operations.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Spark Hire Intro Video
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Accounting Task – Reconciliation & Variance Analysis
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have strong GAAP/IFRS accounting experience, can independently manage close and reconciliations, and take pride in producing accurate, decision-ready financial information, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

raw.description:
Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history: www.spreetail.com.

Work Your Way:

At Spreetail, we believe in empowering our employees to work in the way that suits them best through our Work Your Way approach. Each team member has the flexibility to choose where they work most effectively each week—whether that's from home, a coffee shop, or the office. While flexibility is key, we also value the power of in-person connection. That’s why we bring our corporate team together in Lincoln each quarter for a week of intentional collaboration, team building, community engagement, and our All-Hands meeting. It’s the best of both worlds: the freedom to work your way, with meaningful opportunities to connect and grow together. Please scroll to the bottom of the job posting to confirm that your state qualifies for the Work Your Way program.

Spreetail is looking for a Director, Business Development to help drive our next phase of growth by building and expanding high-value partnerships across China and the U.S. This role is ideal for a native Mandarin speaker with a strong understanding of the Chinese eCommerce landscape and the ability to build relationships and close business across both international and domestic markets. You’ll lead cross-border business development in China, identifying and securing strategic brands and partners, while simultaneously driving domestic U.S. business development with high-potential brands. You’ll work directly with senior executives, develop new business opportunities, negotiate strategic partnerships, and represent Spreetail at key industry events—all with a direct impact on our vendor pipeline, revenue, and $50M+ GMV growth opportunities.

How will you achieve success:

  • Build a $50M+ GMV book of business as the senior leader on the team — this isn't a supporting role; you carry a pipeline and a number.
  • Independently build your ICP and source your own targets — no reliance on inbound or handoffs; you identify the right brands and the right contacts, and you drive the relationship from day one.
  • Run your pipeline with the same rigor a leader would expect from a team — disciplined CRM and KPI management to prioritize the vendors most likely to close, reflecting the standard you'd set if you were managing others.
  • Shape pitch strategy at a senior level — tailoring approach across SMB and Enterprise, category by category, with the judgment of someone who's operated close to the top of a BD org.
  • Report your GMV and close performance directly to senior leadership — your results carry real visibility into the business, functioning as a benchmark for what strong individual performance looks like at Spreetail.

What experiences will help you in this role:

  • Proven ability to close cross-border partnerships with Chinese manufacturers entering the US market — backed by fluency in Mandarin and English, with the negotiation instincts to navigate both language and cultural dynamics solo.
  • A track record of personally closing $50M+ GMV deals — 8+ years of hands-on ownership from first outreach through signature, operating at a strategic deal size that reflects this role's seniority.
  • Deep knowledge of ecommerce fulfillment and marketplace operations — able to speak credibly to how a brand's products move from vendor onboarding through Amazon, Walmart, or Target fulfillment, so you can sell the full value of the partnership, not just the deal terms.
  • Trade show sourcing and P&L/costing negotiation experience — comfortable prospecting in person and managing the financial mechanics of a deal, from program terms to margin trade-offs.
  • C-suite and owner-level selling experience — comfortable pitching and closing directly with founders, National VPs of Sales, and SMB owners, adjusting your approach deal by deal.
In an effort to Make Spreetail Better, we hire people that are aligned with our values and are passionate about pursuing ecommerce excellence. We believe the right person can learn what is needed to succeed in their role, so we encourage job applicants to apply even if you don't meet all the qualifications listed. We are looking for diverse backgrounds and perspectives, so we don’t require college degrees and welcome non-linear career paths. If this role highlights your experience and gets you excited – please apply!
What you can expect from us:
• We provide the flexibility to take care of yourself. Spreetail operates in a work culture that promotes results and encourages taking time off when needed. In addition to a generous vacation policy, we also offer paid time-off for your wedding week, paid parental leave and support for parents of growing families.
• We celebrate accomplishments. Each year at Spreetail is a milestone with the opportunity to receive special gifts, swag store credit, or donations to a nonprofit of your choice. We also recognize people pursuing impacts with Spreetail Spotlight Awards.
• We care about your Health & Wellness. Spreetail works hard to enhance the employee experience through benefit programs and perks that provide meaningful support. We offer affordable medical, dental and vision plans with coast-to-coast coverage. We also provide free telehealth and on-demand mental health resources.
• We create the opportunity to revolutionize your community. We encourage Spreetailers to give back and make a social impact, and we offer paid time off to do it.
Spreetail is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Spreetail is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please email .

Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Dakota, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

raw.description:
This position will operate on a remote basis.

Our Valnet tech brands (including Pocket-lint, MakeUseOf, Android Police, XDA, and How-To Geek) represents leading authorities in consumer tech, digital entertainment, and smart lifestyle media—reaching tens of millions of readers with authoritative features, deep-dive guides, and entertainment recommendations.

As worldwide leaders in the digital publishing space, our tech publications are expanding their coverage and we are currently looking for a Entertainment Features Writer to join our team on a 1099 freelance basis.

Your Responsibilities

  • Pitch and write original features, curated watchlists, franchise rankings, plot explainers, and deep-dive analysis on major movies, TV shows, and streaming platforms (Netflix, Max, Disney+, Prime Video, Apple TV+).
  • Pitch unique, reader-obsessed feature topics regularly (e.g., streaming hidden gems, franchise watch orders, character breakdowns, platform feature deep dives).
  • Input work into our in-house CMS, as well as find and format images, according to our guidelines.
  • Stay ahead of upcoming release slates, streaming ecosystem updates, and pop-culture trends to pitch timely feature angles.
  • Coordinate with editorial teams across brands for assignments, feedback, and content optimization.
  • Follow general Editorial Guidelines while producing unique and high-quality feature content.

What We Offer

  • Competitive per-story compensation.
  • Flexible schedule.
  • Remote position to work from a location of your choice.
  • Exposure to a massive global audience across multiple top-tier tech and media publications, providing you an exciting opportunity to make a genuine impact.

Experience and Skills

  • Relevant experience in writing and editing entertainment features, TV/movie listicles, or pop culture feature content in the English language.
  • Strong ability to pitch original feature concepts and write engaging, reader-focused feed content.
  • Deep knowledge of the current streaming landscape (Netflix, Max, Disney+, Hulu, Prime Video, Apple TV+) and major media franchises.
  • Ability to think analytically and turn complex plots, lore, or streaming trends into clear, readable, and exciting articles.
  • Proficiency with SEO practices for feature writing and experience using a web-based CMS.
  • A self-starter attitude with a passion for staying ahead of the entertainment curve.

How to Apply

If you are interested in this role, please send us the following documentation by uploading it in the relevant fields below:

  • Your CV and a cover letter telling us why you want to write entertainment feature content for our tech network.
  • At least 2-3 published entertainment features, listicles, or pop-culture articles that demonstrate your writing abilities.
  • Links to your portfolio or relevant social profiles.

Our hiring team will review your application and contact you if we believe that your experience could be a match for this role.

Valnet, founded in 2012, is a global digital publishing and media investment Company that owns and operates over 25 authoritative brands across diverse verticals, including entertainment, sports, technology, automotive, gaming, lifestyle and travel.

Valnet is committed to producing premium content, and we therefore require all our contributors to adhere to our Editorial Standards, including a prohibition on using Artificial Intelligence.

Full-Stack Engineer (TypeScript)

Company

Orcrist builds the Orcrist Intelligence Platform (OIP), a secure, Kubernetes-native data intelligence product delivered as SaaS or self-hosted/on-prem—including air-gapped deployments. We serve defense, law-enforcement, and enterprise teams that rely on mission-ready software.

Role

Join the Core squad that owns OIP’s web app, APIs, and admin experiences. You’ll ship end-to-end TypeScript features (Next.js + Node.js/tRPC), harden IAM UX, and ensure secure-by-default workflows used by every customer.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain admin consoles, IAM flows, notifications, and collaboration features.
  • Implement secure auth patterns with Keycloak/OpenFGA and expose tamper-evident audit views.
  • Deliver accessible, performant React components with robust testing and telemetry.
  • Participate in on-call, observability, and incident response for Core services.
  • Collaborate closely with Design, Platform, and customer-facing teams to prioritize impact.

About you

  • 3–7 years building production-grade TypeScript applications across frontend + backend.
  • Strong experience with React/Next.js, Node.js/tRPC (or similar), and modern testing tools.
  • Familiar with OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC/ABAC, and secure UI patterns.
  • Comfortable with Kubernetes/GitOps workflows and participating in on-call rotations.
  • Eligible to work in Germany; EU/NATO citizenship preferred for export control.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with real-time collaboration (WebSockets, CRDTs), accessibility, or design systems.
  • Exposure to Temporal.io, graph/map visualization, or regulated industry products.
  • German language (B1+) or prior work with defense/law-enforcement customers.

What We Offer

  • Modern TypeScript stack, real security + observability challenges, and high autonomy.
  • Remote-first in Germany, hybrid office in Berlin, 30 days vacation, equipment budget.
  • Mission-driven work with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

Platform Reliability Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Platform Reliability Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Platform Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems in production. As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. The ideal candidate will combine deep systems knowledge with strong programming skills, a measurement-driven mindset, and the discipline to design, automate, and operate complex services so that reliability becomes a first-class engineering deliverable rather than a reactive concern.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience supporting large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to build robust automation and tooling.
  • Deep, hands-on experience operating Linux at scale, including networking, performance tuning, and systems-level troubleshooting.
  • Production experience operating Kubernetes and container-based workloads.
  • Strong working knowledge of observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, or commercial equivalents.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Solid understanding of distributed system design, including consistency models, partitioning, and failure semantics.
  • Demonstrated experience leading incident response and conducting effective post-incident reviews.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience defining and operationalizing SLOs and error budgets in real production environments.
  • Exposure to chaos engineering practices and tools such as Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, or Litmus.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Background in capacity planning, performance engineering, or large-scale load testing.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, or Consul.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
